sin dhu ra dang sbyar ba yis: padma 'dab bzhi lte 'ab ni: mu khyud phyi ngan bcas pa bri: dbus su mūṃ dang phyogs bzhir yang: ha ri ni sa bzhi yis bskor: de ltengs sha lnga bdud rtsis lnga sbyar ba'i bskang: stegs bu ba bdam mchod pas brgyan: de dbul su bzhugs pa la: mdun phyogs bdag nyid bde bar bdug: rtsa gsum la la skyabs sems bskyed: spyan drangs bzhugs sol phyag mchod sogs: yan lag bcu yis tshogs bsags bstem: mdun gyi sa mchod rten te gnas pa'i sa phyogs de bandha dur khrod kyi: gzhal yang khang sa rgya khyon bcas: mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus: padma dmar po 'dab bzhi yi: lte bar bdag nyid hūṃ las gu ru ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku dog gnag: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan: phyag yas rdo rje g.yon ka pā la: khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin: spyi gtsug rta mog ljang zhur mtsher: zhabs gnyis nyi zla ro gdan gnas: mdun mum las khros ma nag: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug: g.yon pa thod khrag yab la 'khyud: spyi gtsug phag zhal gathing kha ngur: rus pa'i rgyan can zhabs gnyis 'khril: ra tsa hri ya dpo'i 'bru: ye ge hūṃ rdzogs dpa'o yab: ha ri si sa dpa' yo'i 'bru: yig ge mūṃ rdzogs mkha' 'gro yab yum: thabs shes sku lnga dbyings ye shes: 'du 'bral med pa'i yab yum gsal: badzra gu rug ḍāka ḍākki ni sa ma ya dzā: zhes ye shes pa spyan drangs: gtor ma bstod lha'idakyil 'khor la: padma sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar bsams la: zhi āoṃ āḥhūṃ badzra gu ru padma sems dha ha ni sa ra tsa hri ya i dam bha ling kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes gsum gsum gyi lhag ma med par dgyes par gsol bar mos: sā mā yā: rgyun gyi gtor ma byin brlabs pa: tshogs su rol bar bya ba nyid: sā mā yā: bzla ba'i snying po sngags bsten pa: gu ru tsi ta badzra sidha sa ma ya lo ga dharma sarba sidhi hūṃḥ

snyang po 'di ni 'bum phrag gsum: bzlas na padma bdag nyid ni: dngos nyams rmi lam gang rung 'byung: thun 'tshams bstod pa bya ba ni: hūṃ chags med rgya mtsho pa sdong rtser: ya mtshan rmad byung padma'i sku: skye med rang bzhin chos kyi sku: mtshan dpe gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs: cir yang snang ba sprul pa'i sku: yon tan phrin las mngon rdzogs pa'i: rje btsun padma dbang gi lha: khyed la bdag lus dang bas 'dud: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod par 'bul: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: zhes bstod dbyer med ngad du bzhag: dge ba sems can don du bsngo: yang dril bsgrub thabs rtsa ba'i bcud: thugs kyi bsgrub pa 'di bkod do: lnga ldan skyes bu de dang sprod: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: ༄༅/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las kun 'dus bla ma'i bsgrub thabs bdud 'dul rgyal po'i dril bsgrub bzhugs so/ zangs shog dmar po'i chos sde'o/ ༄༅/ 00000000/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus bla ma rje: zhi khro rab 'byam 'bar 'phro zhing : thugs rjes mdzad pa mtha' yas pa: bdag nyid pad ma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs las can don du ni: kun 'dus bla ma'i sgrub thams bshad: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las: dang po skyebs 'gro bya ba ni: na mo zhi khro rab 'byams kun 'dus pa: 'gyur med rtsa gsum lhod la: bdag sogs 'gro kun gus pa yis: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems skyed spyi dang 'dra: gsum pa gsol 'debs dung ba'i: tshig bdun ma'i gsol ba 'debs: dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum: gzhal yas dbus su pad ma dang : nyi zla baṃ chen khri steng du: bdag nyid khro rgyal dbang chen sku: dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyi gtsug rta mgo rta skad tsher: phyag g.yas mgan lcags rdo rje 'phyar: sde brgyad bdud dpung thal bar brlog: g.yon pa lcags sdig 'gyed stabs 'dzin: gnod byed gdug pa hab kyis 'debs:

rus pa'i brgyan ldan khro gar brjid: me dpung dbus su bdud bzhi snon: g.yon nas rdo rje khros ma nag: dur khrod chas gsol gru gug g.yas: khams gsum 'khor ba'i rnam rtog bcod: g.yon pa tshe bum yab zhal stob: srid gsum bcud bsdus yab la 'dren: spyi gtsug phag zhal ngur ba yis: sa 'og gdug pa'i tshogs rab 'dul: yab yum sku la me 'od 'phro: spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng : zhi ba rigs bsdus thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje 'chang gis cha lugs can: 'thing ka gcer bu rus pas brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu: dbyings phyug dkar mo gri thod can: nu ma 'bur zhing bha ga rgyas: rdo rje padma'i tshul gyi bzhugs: rin chen dar dang rus pas brgyan: zung 'jug bde nyams ldan par bskyed: mkha' lding rgyal po ka ru ṇas: dbu gtsug brgyan cing srid pa gsum: dpa' bo mkhro 'gro grangs med pas: rang gis bka' nyan bran byed bsam: spyi bor rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dang : mgrin par ratna mkha' khro yab yum dang : snying kar bhruṃ mkha' 'gro yab yum dang : lte bar padma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yab yum dang : gsang bar las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum bskyed: sku mdog phyag mtshan so so'i rigs dang mthun: so so'i thugs kar rang srog mtshan: snying po 'di la 'bad med bzlas: āoṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥmaḥ khroṃḥ.ā liḥkā liḥhaḥriḥniḥpaḥraḥtsaḥhriḥyaḥtsi ta hring hring hring ma hā ghu ru dzaḥ lo ka dharma siddhi pha la hūṃ āḥ gsang sngags 'bum du bzlas par bya: thun bar rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni: de ltar snang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: du mar snang yang rang du cig: lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha: dag nges gsang snying po 'di: lha sras 'jing yon srad po khyed: nges med spyod pa skyong ba'i: yid gdengs chos su gdams mo rgya: 'di yis rdzogs rim dug lnga lam khyer ni: 'chongs shog smug po'i ngos la on rgyan: rang nyams len las kun la khar ma dbyung :

snying po'i bcud kyi snod ngan chag par nges: ma mo gza' dang rdo rje legs pa yis: gter 'di thub par 'chongs gcig sā mā yā: bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel zhi khro bla ma yi: bsgrub thabs las tshogs rtsa ba 'dir dkod de: las bya dbang phyogs gzhan nas kha bskong : gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: dam rgya: gnyan rgya: zangs shog dmar po'i ngos las bya bral ratnas spro lung gi lcags khrod du phab pa'o: zhus so/ yag po rang ma byung bas/ dgongs med khrol bar zhu/ 'di bris dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ sems can sangs rgyas thob par shog /// / dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las:bla ma'i gsang bsgrub yang gsang hūṃ gcig ma'o: :000000: sku gsum yongs rdzogs lha la 'dud: bdag nyid padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kun: kha tshang don 'dril mang sbas kyang : yang gsang snying po hūṃ sgrub 'di: kun gyi snying po yin no bu: ma 'ongs lha sras thugs dam du: lkog yig rtsis rgyar akthaṃ rgya: sā mā yā: dben pa'i gnas su ma dhal bsham: mdun du bskyed ltar lha yi sku: lugs sam ri mor bris pa dgram: rang rig sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas phyir: sgrub rdzas mchod gtor bsham mi 'tshal: spyan drangs mchod phrin bskul ba'ang med: rig rtsal ngar ldan rnal 'byor pas: dang po chos rnams dmigs su med: de las 'gro ba snying rjer gsal: mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du: bdag nyid padma thod phreng rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: spyan gsum rab bgrad aṃ rtsigs gnyer: dbu skra smin la ag dmar ser tshoms 'bar: phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs: dpag gtum stag steng dgra bgegs kyi: gdan la log 'dren tshogs kun gzir: sku la khra chung dpag med 'phro: rdo rje med 'bar gur nang bzhugs: thugs khar nyi dbus hūṃ me 'bar: bdag gzhan log rtog bag chags bsregs: rig pa'i ngar ldan hūṃ sgra sgrog:

'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis: sa dang bar snang nam mkha' khengs: de rnams zhal nas hūṃ sgra sgrog: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes ngar ldan brjod: 'jig rten khams kun shig shig ldeg: stong gsum thams cad hūṃ sgras gang : snang srid ma ma lus rlung tshub kyis: rtsi sbur ji bzhin dbang bsdus zhing : srid gsum 'khor ba dong sprug bsam: sgyid snyoms le lo the tshom spang : skabs su stang stabs gar yang bsgyur: nyams nga'i phyogs su thog rdzis bya: ji ltar bshad pa ltar sgrub mthar phyung bas: bag dra nyams 'ur byin chen phebs: dgra dang bgegs rnams dngas rgyas 'bros: mkha' 'gro thams cad bran du 'khol: rang lus sbrid cing kun nas 'phar: dmigs pa bdar gtad dbang du 'du: skal ldan rab kyis zhag bdun te: 'bring gi gnyis la tha mas kyang : bdun phrag gsum gyis rtags phul phyin: de bar 'tshams gcad dam gces: grub rtags bdag nyid zhal mthong dang : bdag dang dbyer med rtog pa 'char: gang sgrubs las kun thog med 'grub: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i dam tshig tu: bzang la mi re ngan mi dogs: yin min the tshom yid byed sogs: tha mal zhe 'dod mtha' dag spang : rang nyid gu ru padma bdag: yin pa'i 'du shes dus kun du: 'bral ba med par mchog tu gces: bde gshegs kun 'dus bla ma yi: bsgrub thabs gsang snying hūṃ sgrub 'dir: mtshan bdun kun 'dus gro lod te: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus de ru: padma khro bo'i skur bstan la: ye shes pa dang 'jig rten zhes: dbye bar byed pa'i dus 'byung gis: don du rang snang padmar te: ye shes bltas ye shes pa: 'jig rten ltar bltas 'jig rten pa: nga la 'di zhes rtsis khrigs med: rnam pa sgra yis don tshol na: kro ta lo kota ta ra te: zur chag 'bru bsdus gro lod zhes: khro bo 'jig rten 'das par 'gyur: de ltar yang zab gsang bsgrub 'di: nga yi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin cing : 'brel tshad thar pa'i don ldan pa:

lha sras skye ba de dang sprod: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya: rgya bdun gyis btab te lha sras snying gi rtsis rgyar gdams so: 'bri gung bya bral ratnas bu tshal pho brang du dag par phab yod/

/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las:bla ma gsang bsgrub kyi byin brlabs bzhugs: 'di yi byin brlabs bya bar 'dod na: mdun du ma dhal gyi steng tshom bu bkod: gtor ma rdo rje ma dpe'u chung ltar gzheng la: rdo rje phur bu rnams lta gon bya: mchod pas bskor zhing bsnyen pa dang rang dbang chub par bya'o: de nas slob ma khrus bya bgegs bskrad rdo rje me ri'i bsrungs 'khor bsgom: e ma bla ma rdo rje 'dzin: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs gsang ba: bde gshegs thugs srog dam pa yi: byin brlabs bdag la stsal du gsol: zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab: bla mas dam tshig bsrungs bar bka' sgo dam chu slud: slob ma padma thod phreng du bskyed la: snying khar g.yung drung dang ha ri ni sa hūṃ gis sbyor bas bdag nyid kyi byin phab cing : bla mas 'di skad ces byin bskul lo: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: rje btsun chen po padma tod phreng du rtsal: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gnas rin po che: khyad par thugs rjes bod kyi sems can gzigs: las ngan spyad pa'i rnam smin gyis mnar ba'i: bdag cag rjes 'jurjes 'brang slob ma rnams: thugs kyi 'dor ram ma hā gu ru rje: thugs rje yal yol btang snyoms mnga' ba na: yang sangs rgyas pa'i dgos pa ci zhig 'chis: bdag cag lus ni gdungs pas 'chi ma 'khrug: gsol 'debs 'dor 'bod pa cang gsan nam: yid ni rtse gcig khyed kyi yon tan dran: pha yi thugs rjes gzigs cig rin po che: bu la byin gyis brlobs cig sprul pa'i sku: lus la bde ba spor cig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ngag la nus pa bskyed cig yi dam lha: sems la rtogs pa spor cig gu ru rje: 'dir tshogs mos pa'i bu la byin chen phob: lus la 'gyur med sku yi byin phob cig: ngag la tshangs dbyangs gsung gis byin phob cig: sems la 'khrul med thugs kyis byin phob cig: yon tan 'gran zla bral ba'i byin phob cig:

phrin las 'gro 'dul rnams bzhis byin phob cig: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub byin phob cig: zhes dang hūṃ gi sgra drag cing mang bar brjod: lus kyi gar bsgyur bas slob ma rnams la byin dngos sum du phebs pa'i rtags ma byung na: padma bdag gis yi radam bcas pa nyams par 'gyur ro: thugs dam bskul ba 'di la yadi gnyis the tshom med par yid dam du byas gsosha ba btab na: zangs mdog dpal ri pudam 'od kyi klong nas: bdag gis dad pa de'i lab snag 'dren par the tshom med de na rag kan: kha tsam tshig tsam kyis ni ma yin no: de ltar byin phab pa'i ye shes de nyid ngo sprod pa ni: 'o rig kyi bu rnams: ye gdodam nas rang rig pudam thod phreng rtsal 'di ltar bu yodatha kyi ngo shes pa de: de res gu ru padma'i thugs rjes dang 'di ltar rdu rkyen gyi rten 'brel 'dzem pas: sngan chad ngo ma shes pa de: da ni shes te ye re: sale: wa le: lam me: ngo bo ci yang ma yin la: rnam pa gang gi 'ang sgo mi 'gag pa:'di ni byin phab pa'i byi rlabs su ngo shes par gyis la: de las gzhan du: ma rtog: ma spro: ma bsdu: rang sor zhog cig: 'di na ma bcos rang byung gi ye shes yin te: 'di las ma g.yos na: 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pas padma 'byung gnas so: yon tan kun gyi ngo bor bzhugs pas padma bam bha'o: shes bya thabs cad gsal bas blo ldan mchog srid do: kham gsum lus kyi bdag po yin pas padma rgyal po'o: mi shes pa'i mun pa kun sangs pa'i nyi ma 'od zer ro: bdud bzhi kun gyis mi rji ba shākya seng ge'o: lta ba bzang ngan gyi phyogs su ma lhung ba seng ge sgra sgrog go: bgegs dang log 'dren kun 'dul pa'i rdo rje gro lod do: rigs kyi bu de ltar sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad kyang rang rig pa'i ye shes padma thod phreng rtsal 'di yin no: zhes ngos sprad la brtan par bya ba'i phyir gtor ma dang sku 'bag gis dbang bskur ba ni:

:hūṃ: snang stong ma 'gags rig pa'i sgo: rang rig padma thod phreng rtsal: sku gzugs rjas gyis dbang bskur ro: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: zhes rjes bzlos bya zhing: rdo rje hūṃ bcas mgrin par bskur ro: hūṃ sangs rgyas 'phris gcig bsdus pa: thugs mchog 'dus pa kī la ya: dug lnga bsgrol ba'i dbang bskur bas: phrin las yongs rjogs 'grul gyur cig: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: zhes snying gar bskur ro: de nas tshagos la longs spyad: ma dhal dbul: rjes kyi bya ba rnams gzhan dang 'dra'o: yang gsang thugs sgrub hūṃ gcig gi: byin brlab dbang gi rim pa 'di: padma bdag gis legs bkod cing: phyi rabs las can don du gdams: lnga ldan bu dang 'di rad shog: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: yang gsang hūṃ gis rtags rdzogs nas:0zhi ba'i las tshogs bya 'dod na: rang rig hūṃ dkar dri med las: grangs med spros pas nad gdon zhi: hūṃ gi sgra sgrogs bsrung bya bskor: dan gdon bar char zhi bar 'gyur: rgya pa'i las tshogs bya 'dod na: rang rig hūṃ ser dri med las: grangs med spros pas tshe dpal rgyas: hūṃ gi sgra sgrogs bdud rtsi dang: zas nor car pa babs par bsam: dbang gi las tshogs bya 'dod na: rang rig hūṃ ljang mtshon mo 'bar: gang gnod rdul du brlag par bsam: hūṃ bsgrag stang stabs 'tsham rngam bya: dgregs gdug pa zhi tshar gcod na: gzhan yang las tshogs gang 'dod kyang: hūṃ sgra sgrog cing dmigs pa dang: byams dang snying rje'i bsam pa bsgyur: ji ltar 'dod pa yid bzhin 'grub: gu ru'i gsang ba hūṃ gcig 'di: kun la mi bsatan snying gi bu: rang nyams logs la gzhan don spyod: las ldan rnams kyi dpal du shog: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan rin po che'i phyag bris kyi bu dung shog dkar po'i chos sde las: dbu rtsal pho brang du dag par phab yod// gcig zhus// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: gsang thugs phag lnga'i sgrub thab bzhugs so:

0000000000: rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: la lus 'khor dang bcas la 'dud: gsang ba sngags kyi bcud phyung ba'i: snying po ḍākka'i sgrub thabs bshad: sā mā yā: sku dang gsung dang thugs yon tan: phrin las la sogs ji snyid dang: rdo rje rin po che padma las: de bzhin rigs mchog sna tshogs dang: dam tshigs snang tshogs sha za dang: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ji rnyed pa'i: sgrub thabs sna tshogs mang mchis kying: kun gyi nang nas yang gsang mchog: bya sla tshogs chung 'grub nye zhing: las rnams sna tshogs rab yur ba: gsang ba thugs kyi phag lnga 'di: gu ru padma bdag nyid la: dur khrod ro gling tshal chen du: rdo rje phag mos dngos su gnang: 'di yi rdu dang sgrub thabs las:rgyas par mon kha'i brag la yod: 'dir ni snying po bsdus te bstan: gzhi ni dang lus 'byung ba lnga: phung po lnga yi tshul gnas pa: ye shes rnam lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs: 'di spangs logs nas rten mchod rdzas: sgrub blo'i bye brag g.yong ba ni: gzhan nas tshol ba ngal ba'i rdu: 'byung ba sa las tshur ba'i phung: sha rus mnyam nyid ren po chen rigs: 'byung ba chu dang rnam par shes: khrag khamasasha me longs rdo rje'i rigs: 'byung ba mo dang 'du shes phung: drod ni sor rtog padma'i rigs: 'byung ba rung dang 'du byed phung: dbugs ni byang grub las kyi rigs: 'byung ba nam mkha' gzugs phung dbyings: chos dbyings sangs rgyas mkha' gro ste: kun 'dus de bzhin gshegs ma'o: sku ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro la: gsung ni padma thugs sangs rgyas: yon tan rin po che phris las: mchog las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro matso: zhi la do rje mkha' 'gro ste: rgyas pa ratna dbang padma: mngos spyod karma mkha' 'gro gtso: de bzhin phyogs kyang dbus sangs rgyas: shar ni rdo rje lhor ratna: nub tu padma byang karmā: gtso mo gang byed skabs dang sbyar: 'khor gyi khang bur rigs te dbab: ye shes dbyings su gcig pa'i phyir:

gdul byi'i dbang gis gtso 'khor las: don dam khri gsu bcad pa med: mthar thugs rigs lnga'i rnam pa yang: rigs chen yongs rdzogs gcig tu rdzogs: don dam rdo rje phag mo ni: blo yi spyod yul las 'das shing: tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa te: brjod pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pas: rdo rje phag mo zhes pi brjod: rdo ni bem shes rig pa'i dzogs: rje ni 'khor 'das kun dbang bsgyur: phag ni bzang ngan blang dor med: mo ni dus kun bskyed pa'i yum: de phyir rdo rjanye phag mo ste: rang rig rnal 'byor ma zhes bya: rang ni 'khor 'das rang snang chos: rig pa du gsum skye 'jigs bral: rnal ni 'od gsal ma bcos pa: 'byor ni thams cad de ru 'du: ma ni kun gyi ngo bor mnyam do phyir rnal 'byor ma zhes bya: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas: gnas skabs bar chad mi mthun zh-id: tsho dpal longs spyod dpal 'byor rgyas: mos gzhis 'khor 'das dbang du 'du: mi dang min dgra bgegs bsgrol: gdos bcas phung po zag pa bsrog: ye shes gting gsal mngon du 'byin: lam rtags yon tan zhal la 'char: sku dang ye shes 'khor lo gsal: yon tan thams cad 'di las 'byung: nyes tshagos mi mthun 'di yis 'joms:de phyir ḍākki sgrub pa'i thabs: bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa'i tshul du bstan: sā mā yā ste.akthi rgya: :dang po gsang ba la mos shing: mkha' 'gro'i lam zhugs rnal 'byor pas: gnas skabs kha na ma tho ba: spang phyir rten dang sgrub pa'i chas: logs bshams kha ni nub tu bstan: na ma byin brlabs dngos grub kun rtsol bar chad sol: bla ma yi dam mkha' gro la skyabs mchi: ye nas rang lus phung khams lhar bzhugs pa'i: rtsa rlung thig gsum la skyabs su mchi: rang rig skye 'gag gnas gsum mtha' bral ba'i:don dam rdo rje phag mo la skyabs mchi: phyi ru yan lag lnga yis gsol zhing bsngo: thams cad rigs pa skye med klong du mu:

de las 'khrul mdangs sems can snying re brje: de phyir o las nam mkha' chos kyi dbyings: rgya khyon bral ba'i mkha' klong mthing gsal dbus: dug lnga'i rtogs tshogs phyi snod rnam dag pa: 'byung bzhi dur khrod 'bar ba'i sa gzhi la: bdag gir 'dzin 'joms koṃ rus ri rab dang: ban dha rlon phrong rab 'jigs pas: ye nas dag pa'i 'dor sba klong 'khrug:de dbus 'khor 'das nyam yangs padma dang: rang byung 'od gsal nyi zla rtog bral gyi: baṃ chen ro steng bdag gzhan bzhacud sems can: bdag 'dzin stong dbyings shes rab phag mo ni: chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog gnag cing 'tshor: du gsum skyai 'jig bral ba'i gzhon nu'i tshul: nu ma 'bur zhing sha rgyas bha ga 'bur: ye shes zhi las thugs rjes rjes 'dzin pas: zhi zhing khro la cung zad chags nyams zhal: bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i dbu skra grol: stong gi phag zhal gyon phyogs nam mkha' ngur: mchog dman dbyir med bde chen dbyings su sbyor: gzung 'dzin yul mkhan rtsad gcod phyag g.yas gri gug dang: rang g.yon thod pa'i nang du rtsal ye shes bcud rdzogs 'dud rtsi dang khrag mthung: rang don mi dmigs zhabs g.yas gsang bar rol: 'khor ba mi gtong byang sems zhabs g.yon gar: ye shes yongs rdzogs thod skam dbu brgyan dang: rlon pa'i don shal rus brgyan me tog phreng: snang rig thabs che kha ṭwaṃ gu mos 'khyud: dug gsum ma spangs sku bstod glang zhing rkod stag smad spag gsol: gzhan rtog 'dzin yul 'khor gyi mkha' gro bzhi zho sdang kun gsal me long rdo rje'i rigs:mdun gyi 'dab dmar ma rdo rje thod: nga rgyal kun 'joms mnyam nyid rin chen rigs: lho yi 'dab ma ser mo rin chen thod: 'dod chags kun 'jug sor rtogs padma'i rigs: nub kyi 'dab dmar mo padma thod: phrag dog kun byed bya grub las kyi rigs: byang gi 'dab mar ljang mo rgya gram thod: kun kyang rtags phag zhal so sor gsal:

rgyan dang cha lugs brkyad bskum gtso dang mtshungs: gzugs su grub tshad sku snang stong āoṃ: sgra ru grags tshad gsung ste grags stongs āṃ: yid kyi rtog tshogs thugs to don stong hūṃ: gang du'ang bsgrur bar nus pa'i dkar po dang: kun gyi go 'byin nus pa dmar zhing gsal: gcig las bsgrur du med med las gathing ga'i mdog: gtso 'khor gnas rnams yi ges mtshan cing brlab: phyi snod rnam rang dag pa gzhal yas khang: nang bcud ba gan ye shes phag lnga'i skur: ye nas dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med: dbang ni gang gis bskur zhing gang la bskur: mchog dang dman pa'i rtogs pa sbad kyis bcad: sgra ru bsgags pa sngags kyi 'khor lo: snang ba'i bdang gis sgra bsgyur grangs mang kyang:mi 'gags mi gnas chos rnams kun gyi ma: zhi rigs bsdus rdo rje gzhom zhig bral: de ni kun 'joms gzhan gyi zil mi mnon: ni 'khor 'das kun thog bde don dang: ni srid zhi'i brtan yon 'dzin pa che: kun 'dus yi ge aḥha ri ni sa: rang gyi mtha' ru 'byon pa'i ye ge lnga: de ni sku gsung thugs bstan pa na: oṃ dang āḥdang hūṃ dang gi bdag nyid de: gzhan don skun nas sgo yi ge gsum: bdag gzhan gnyis med don spyod nyer bsgrub pa'i: bsnyen dang nye bsnyen bsgrub dang nye bsgrub dang: las dang las sbyor gcig dril gsang ba'i sngags: gnad nas bskul ba'i thugs srog yig 'bru dgu: thun mong dngos grub rtsol ba'i 'bru lngas brgyan: 000000000: gtso mo'i snyeng dbul nye mar rang srol srog mthar: gsang sngags 'gyal mo bzhin du 'khor bar bsam: nyid mtshan 'bad pas dzāb tu bzla bya zhing: 'de 'dor dmar pos dbang bsdus nag por bstem: phyogs 'tshams stong 'og zhing kun khyab pa yis: so so'i khams g.yos snang srid 'khor 'das kun: mer mer khyom khyom 'gul ldog thams cad bsdus: rang la thim pas mchog thun dngos grub thob:

ṛg pa hūr phyur rig ma dngas 'gag med bskyang lus ngag yid kyi bya byed rtsis gdengs phral : snang ba khral btang ma gcos bcos med bya: des ni 'khor 'das rdzun khung gting : srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i mkhar po bskyel: khams gsum ma lus gtad med spra yas shes: phyi ltar ma hā'i tshul du bsgrub pa yi: 'kha' 'gro lnga'i bskyed rdzogs e ma ho: sā mā yā: nang lus 'byung lnga rnams dag gzhal yas lha: rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i 'khor lo lnga: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro chos 'khor lo gathing: rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde chen 'khor lo dkar: rin chen mkha' 'gro sprul pa'i 'khor lo ser: padma'i mkha' 'gro longs spyod 'khor lo dmar: las kyi mkha' 'gro bde stong 'khor lo ljang: rtsa yis ṛng ngan mkha' 'gro rigs lnga sto: zhal pyag mi gsal 'khor lo'i bdag nyid bzhugs: gsung gi gsang sngags yig 'bru mi gsal te: rgyu byed rmung ni rangs sngags sgrog:thugs ni ye shes lnga mtshon thing le lnga: rang rang mdog mtshungs rang 'khor dbus su 'tsher: grags stong sngags kyi ra yis bskul ba las: lnga ldan thig le 'dor re kun nas 'phro: 'khor lo lnga dang lus kun 'od kyis gang: bde stong dbyer med dang nas spyod lam bskyangs: de ni a nu'i tshul tu tshul phag mo lnga: bsnyen bsgrubs las la sbra ba dril bstan: nyams su blangs pas dgos bcas phung 'dzin 'jig: bdag zhan don byed sprul pa'i 'khrul lus 'grub: gsang sngags rang gra drag cing mnga' dbang phyug: bde gsal mi rtog rtogs bral ye shes 'char: mkha' 'gro lnga'i bskyed rdzogs e ma ho: sā mā yā: āoṃ ā hūṃ: a harin nas: tsita hri hrings ma ya 'dus 'dus: sidha phal ho: rang sems stong pa'i mkha' klong ba zhal yang khang: rig kun khyab sangs rgya mkhor 'gro ma: rig dngos 'gyur med rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: rig ngor mnyam nyid rin chen ḍā kki ma: rig mdas 'gag med padma mkha' 'gro ma:

rig par kun gsal las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: skug go phyag 'tshan 'di zhes ma nges te: 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun gyi tshul: brjod bral gsung med gsung chen sngags kyi sgra: ā l̥ kā l̥ zab mo 'gag pa med: kun gzhi yid sems rig zhes mi dmigs te: dmigs med spros bral mi 'gyur gasprul thugs: sus kyang ma byas ye nas 'du 'bral med: don dam rdo rje phag mo'i gnad 'di bzung: rang nyid ye nas phag mo yin pa la: yin par ma shes rang mig ma mthong 'dra: de yi stong gzugs dri rar reg: gang ltar shar kying rdo rje phag mo'i rtsal: spam blang dgags sgrub mi bya rang lugs gzhag: 'on kyang mi lto de las gzhan ma yin: re dang dogs dang smra bsam brjod dran tshogs: ci shar ci byas rdo rje phag mo'i ngang: de las 'da' rgyu'adug na kye ma ho: rin chen thig lo zhes pa'i tham snyad cing gda'am: des na chad dang yan dang har ba dang: gzhig chen po 'di las 'di las 'di yin dang: 'di na tig le chen por zlum 'di la: phyogs dang ris su phyo ba cang yan gshes tshul la: yin min gdags kyang lto bar 'gyur ram: 'di min zhes lo por pa'i tha snyad da cang gda'am: de bas phyogs med rgya yan gshes tshul la: yin min gdags kyang ltor bar cang 'gyur ram: de la bsgoms dang ma bsgom khyad dar gang: rtogs dang ma rtogs dun kun 'gyur med pas: bdag gzhan 'khor 'das thig le gcig tu zlum: de ltar rang ti la 'khar mthong stong: snang ba mi 'gag mkha' gro'i dkyil 'khor gsal:stong pa'i rang ni sgrib med kar tu 'phro: bdag gzhan dbyor med mkha' spyod longs sku'i zhing: skad gcig gis bgrod chos sku'i rgyal srid thob: de ltar rdzogs chen byar mo phag mo ni: bsnyen cing bsgrub dang las kyi sbyor bral bas: bya byed mtshan ma'i rtsol ba kun nas sangs: gnyis med ye shes rang shugs lhug par rgyas: sangs rgyas zhes su 'dog na do la thogs:

'on kyang ming tshig brta' dang tha snyid kyang: spang blang dgag sgrub med pas ci yang btub: cir yang 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i 'phrul mo che: don dam zung 'jug phag mo la phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsung 'khor 'das mchod par 'bul: lam du nor gol log 'tho lo bshags: rang mdangs 'khrul med chos 'khor bskor du gsol: 'pho 'gyur skye 'jig bral ba'i chos skur bzhugs: bdag gzhan mnyam nyid byu ba sems su bsngo: rnam par rtags kyi rdo rje phag mo ni: mthing nag khro zhal mche gartsigs hūṃ sgra sgrog: spyan gsum sdang mig 'khyug dasral gnyer bsdus: ral pa dmar ser 'bar zhing rgyab grol: thod skam dbu brgyan rlon pa'i do shal can: glang chen zhing g.yang stag spal sku la gsol: rigs lnga'i klu yis sku dang phyag zhabs brgyan: rin chen rus rgyan dar gyi 'phur lding bgos: me tog phring dang or kha'i dril bu 'khrol: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar gyis meya dpung dbus:rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros bskor nas brjed par ni pad nyi baṃ chin stong du bzhugs bstan pa'i: snang srid sku yi dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal bstod: grag pa'i sgra tshogs stong nyid yi go lnga: bde chen ye shes dbyings nas bstong mdzad pa: rgyun mi 'chad par sgrog pa'i tshangs dbyangs can: bcom ldan gsung gi phag mo la phyag la phyag 'tshal: dran shes rig pa'i rtog tshogs stong pa'i ngang: sna tshogs cho 'phul ting 'dzin du ma yis: ji snyid srid pa'i pha mthar sgrol mdzad pa: 'gyur med thugs kyi phag mo la phyag 'tshal: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bdag la rtsol: 'gal rkyen mi thun 'joms pa'i phyin las mdzod: zhesha bstod tshogs 'khor gzhan nas bskang: ye nas rang gnas gsal gdab pas: gzhan du gshegs gsol 'di la med: snang ba'i cha ni bskyed pa sto: stong pa'i dus na rdzogs rim yin: gnyis kyang zung 'jug rdzogs pa che: de ltar gsang sgrub phag lnga yis:

sgrub thabs bye brag bsam yas kyang: gzhan du 'di ltar bstan pa med: 'di ni ma 'ongs tha mi dus: lha sras skye ba brdud pa'i mtha': lha rigs pa ratna'i ming 'dzin cing: mkha' 'gro rtags kyi gsang ba bachang: las lhan bu rnams 'ur zhing 'du: ḍākki ma tshogs 'tshub ltar 'khril: bzang ngan 'bril med shen tu nyung: kun tu grags pa'i bu gcig 'byung: de yis chos skal 'di la spyod: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gtor rgya: zab rgya: sbas rgya: gab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: gnyan rgya: gtad rgya: dam rgya: rgya dgus btab ste ma hā gu ru'i gsung bzhin: lha sras bdag gis g.yu shog ljang skya'i ngos su bris pa'o: de'i bu las 'bri gung bya bral bas bu tshal phrong du phab pa'o// gcig zhus//

dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: gnod sabayin ga'u'i yig chung bzhugs so: gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: ga'u gsang bsgrub kyi gnad kyi gdams pa: rgyal chen dzi bha la mched kyi snying bsgrul chen po'i sngags las kyi moda'u kha bsgyur gyi gnad: yig 'bru lnga pa 'di kho na'o 'di kho na'o: mi 'gugs na: ming rus che cho mo shi shi ni swahā: g.yu 'gugs na g.yu che po mo phi shi ni swāhā: btsan mo 'gugs na: ḍā kki ni che po mo phi shi swāhā: chos 'gug na: na ma budha ya: na mo dharma ya: na mo sang gha ya: gang 'dod pa'i chos phi shi ni swāhā: rtsa ba'i sngags la btags la: rang nyid kyi rnams srasasu bsgoms pa'i mdun du: grang yin pa de hrīḥrtser dgug go: rnams sras mched ga'u la brten nas: bsgrub pa'i thabs phyi nang gsang ba dad bcas pa 'di nyid rgyud kyi dgongs pa mkha' 'gro ma gar mkhan mas ji ltar bstan bzhin: rin po che'i bang mdzod gsang ga'u'i bsgrub thabs 'dir gab sbas med par stan pas nyams su blangs na 'bral bu 'byung ngos so: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gzhan yang rten gsum bzung ste: 'di nyid kyi sku'i rten: ris su bris pa'am: lugs su blug pa'am: 'bur du gtod pa: bskos su gzhengs pa gang rung rab gnas dang ldan pa bzung ngo: gsung gi rten: rgyal chen mched la: sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phris rgyan dang cha lugs nang rtags kyi bstod pa dang: gzung 'bum 'khor la bstod pa dang: gzungs ring thung la sogs pa bsnyen par bya'o: thugs kyi rten: gang la'ang ched mi gnyer: gang bsgrub pa'ang sems can gyi don du dmigs nas spyad: sbyams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bzang po gser lhu bskyed: tshad med pa bzhi bsgom: las rgyu 'bras la brtson ba dang: de dag don du gnyer na ni thugs kyi dam tshigs go: sā mā yā: yig chung dang dam tshig gi zhal gdams:

gnod sbyin ga'u ma'i chas rkyen du gdams pa'o: sā mā yā: gcig zhus// dam chos dgongs yang zab las: gsang ba snying byang gi byi rlabs thugs rje gcig ma zhes pa bzhugs so: 00000: bcom ldan dpal sku gsum 'dus pa'i lha phyag 'tshal lo: kho kho rgya gar mkhas pa padma yis: dus gsum shes bya thogs med mthong ba'i phyir: da ltar gnod sbyin mi sring smin grol dngam 'ongs lha sras mu tig btsad po'i don: gsang ba'i yang byangasnying bya dmar po las: smin byed thugs rje gcig ma'i dbang bskur bstan: sā mā yā: sngon 'gro bkris dag pa'i sa phyigs su: maṇḍal mchod gtor mkho ba'io bya bsag: slob dpon bskyid rdzogs lta ba'i gdos ldan pas: gsal gdab bsnyen pa rang dbang lung nod bya: dngos gzhi slob ma khrus dbying mig dar dang: me tog dang bcas khyi nas 'di skad zhu: kyai: 'gro ba'i mgon po ston pa bla na med: bde shegs kun 'dus bdag la dgongs su gsol: ma rig las kyis mnar ba'i sems can la: thugs rjes rtser dgongs dbang mchog bskur du gsol: gsum bla mas: kyai: skal ldan rigs kyi bu gcig bdag la gsan: gsang ba mchog 'di rab tu gnyen pas na: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig bsrung nus sam: de ltar khas len bdags gis dbang mchog sbyin: sa ma yā i dan te na rag kan: zhes bdud blod: de nas slob ma nang bcud me long mes: bgegs bskrad bsrungs 'khor bsgom la gral du 'khod: kye har: bla ma bde shegs rgyal ba thams cad kyi: byi brlabs ye shes bdag la dbab du gsol: lan gsum gsol gdab slob ma snang mthar bskyed: thugs kar g.yu drung yi ge'i 'gro 'du yis: bde ba can nas ye shes spyan drangs bstim: slob dpon rgyan ldan rol mor bcas pa yis: hriḥnub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: bcom ldan mgon po sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor:

thugs rjes rtser dgongs gnas 'dir byin phob gcig: hrīngaḥ hrīngaḥ hrīngaḥzhes grangs med rjed cing dbab: su sra tikṣas gnyis med bstim zhing brten: de bzhin slob ma spyan ras gzigs su bsgom: sngar bzhin sbyor bas ri bo ta la nas: thugs rjes po zhi lha rigs brgya sogs: spyan drang bstim zhi byin brlabs gyur par bsam: hrīḥ shar phyogs po ta la yi gnas mchog nas: thugs rje chen po 'phags spyan ras gzigs: bde shegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: thugs rjes rtser dgongs gnas 'dir byin phob gcig: hrīḥhrī hrīḥsngar bzhin brtan byi slob ma rte mgrin bskyid: dga' ba'i tshal nas ye shes spyan drangs bstim: hriḥlho nub dga' ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod nas: khro bo'i rgyal po rte mgrin dbang gi lha: bde shegs khro bo'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: thugs rjes rtser dgongs gnas 'dir byin phob gcig: hrīḥhrī hrīḥganyis med bstim pas lus ni 'phar 'khrab g.yo: smra rgod glu dbyangs nyams 'ur phebs pa'i rtags: sngar bzhin bstan rdo rje me tog mis brtan byi: suṣpa p-i dhi bston zhes me tog dbul: suṣpa a bhi ṣi ñtsas dbang bskur sbyin: mig phye phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan: de nas slob dpon bum pas dbang bskur zh-ing: hrīḥ dag byed yes shes bdud dam lha'i tshu: zhi khro rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i bum pa yis: ska ldan dbang bskur dbang bzhi'i gyur cig: hrīḥ gsum ka la sha i bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: bum chu bkrus blud gtor zhing lha dbang bskur: byin dbab tshig bsgyur gnas gsum gtugs byas la: bum pa'i dbang du ngo sprad dag pa brjod: thod pa'i bdu 'di sbyin zhing 'di skad do: hrīḥ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med: long spyod rdzogs sku 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs: sprul sku khro rgyal rta mgrin dbang gi lha: kun 'dus byang sems bdud rtsis dbang bskur ro:

hrīḥgasum bo dhi tsitta a mṛ bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: zhes pas bgrin par gtad cing kha ru blud: ya ra la ba'i rtsa mdud bkrol zhing bdud: ā li kā li'i sgra don gsang dbang du: ngo sprad dag pa brjod la brtan par bya: do nas me long btad la bskur tshig 'di'o: hrīḥreg bya'i bde ba 'jam zhing yi du 'ong: stong gsal mnyam yangs ye shes gsal 'grib med: snang tshogs 'tshar ba shes rab dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan gsang sngags dam par dbang gtor bskur ro: hrīḥsnod bcud rnam dag rton dang brtan par bcas: rang lus phung khams lha dang gzhal yas khang: don dam rig stong 'gyur med bzhi pa'i dbang: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: hrīḥgasum ti ka dzñā na b.ling ta a ṣiñtsa hūṃ: zhes pas gnas rnams kun tu btug cing sbyin: gtor ma 'od zhu bdud rtsil bsams la rol: bzhi par ngo sprad bzhin dag pa brjod: chos 'di'i rgyud 'dzin gzhan don nus pa la: rgyal thabs sbyin zhing bka' bsrungs btad pa ni: dbang bsgrub dpe dang rdzas rnams tshogs byas la: drag po thog gi dkyil 'khor bris pa'i dbus: ha ra'i gtor ma sman rag ling gar bcas: tsa ka lis brgyan bskyed chog dgug cing bstim: de nas slob mar dbang bskur sbyin zhing gtad: hīḥrgyal ba'i bka' dang rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i lung: lha gcig sngags gcig ting nge 'dzin gcig bsdus pa'i: gsang ba'i yang gsang snying byang dmar po'i bskor: dbang rgyud lung dang man ngag gdams pa rnams: lnga spyod dus tshe chos la bsgrub long med: bskyed rdzogs bsnyen bsgrub mtha' ru mi phyin dus: gsang sngags snod dang ldan pa 'byung 'gyur la: gdams po gtod dbang bskur rgyud bshed la: lung byin man ngag gdams pas grol bar gyis: hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ surba dha rmā a bha ṣañtsa hūṃ: zhes pas spo ti bsgrub rdzas bcas byin: hrīḥsngon cho lcang lo can gyi pho brang du: gsang bdag phyag pa rdo rje'i spyan sngar ni:

ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du: ki kang nag po drang po drag po thog 'beb dang: klu mo phung byed sha yang dmar mo'i bu: gnod sbyin po ra nag po ni: gdug pa'i gza' dang pa gdon klu yi 'khor: o rgyan padma'i bka' dang dam bzhin du: chos 'di sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i tshogs: ban dhe glang snying bstan pa'i phung byed rnams: bsgrol zhing rdul du brlag pa'i las mdzod cig: hrīḥha ra nag po sā mā yā dam gtod: dam las ma badha': sā mā yā: na raka kan: zhes pas gtor ma gtad cing kham re bza': bdud rtsi btung zhing dam tshig bsra bar bya: rjes la rten tre tshogs kyi 'khor lo dbul: dal bsdu shis brjod bsngo ba smin lam gdam ba: sā mā yā: de ltar byin brlabs thugs rje gc-ig ma'i dbang: rdzas la rton te dbang bzhi bskur ba'i thabs: gartsug gi nor bu rtag tu bcang ba'i chos: snying nas mos pa'i lha sras khyed la gtad: ma 'ongs snying ma lja spyod dus der ni: lha sras skye ba'i dam chos dpal du shog: ha ra pos bka' 'di dam du chongs: dus la bab tshe las ldan bu lasprod: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gtor rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: lha sras phyag yid 'chong shog smug po'i ngos las: dri med shog dkar dam pa'i ngos su 'bri gung bya bral bas: spra lung lngang khrod du dag par phab pa'o/ madgalaṃ gcig zhus/// / dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: gsang snying byang gi las byang gsang gcig grub zhes pa bzhugs so: 00000000: bcom ldan 'das dpal sku gsum 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag la: sku gsum las byang gsang ba gcig grub 'di: padma bdag gis phyi rabs don du bzhag: rnam gsum khog par gdams so akthaṃ rgya: sngon 'gro dal bum mchod tshogs gtor ba bsham: rang nyid bde ba'i stan la skyil dkrung 'dug: hrīḥbade shegs 'dus pa sku gsum grub pa'i lha: don gnyis mthar phyir rnams la skyabs su 'chi:

zhes skyabs 'gro 'gro kun sangs rgyas byub thob bya'i phyir: byams dang snying rje byang chub sems bskyed de: sems bskyed de: na mo dha rma sam bha kā ya a wā sha ya hriṃ hriṃ: ma ha sarba sdu dza gha na tsakra ho: zhes pas byin dbab mchod pa byin brlabs:dngos gzhi: hriḥ chos dbyings rings stong pa'i ngang nyid las: kun snang 'gro la khyab pa snying rje'i mdangs: rgyu yi ngo bo hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: ting 'dzin gsum dang gzhal yas bskyed pa: 'byung ba rim brtsogs bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus: ye shes lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang: mtshan nyid kun rdzogs bus su bcom ldan 'das: dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ ho: ye shes pa spyan drangs zhing bstim pa'o: hrīḥnas bdag dang gnyis med ye shes lha: rang byang gsal ngang du brtan par bzhugs: bzhugs gsol lo: hriḥbade shegs sku gsum tshogs la: sgo gsum 'du 'bral med par phyag bgyi'o: phyag 'tshal ba'o:^hrīḥ 'khor dang myang 'das phyi nang gsang ba yi: mchod tshogs sman rag gtor ma mchod par 'bul: mchod pa'o: hriḥ dam pa rigs brgya sku gsum 'dus pa'i lha: gnyen lcug 'khri ldem khro tshul gar dgur ldan: snyan 'tsher 'ur chom gsing bag gad rgyangs can: thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshogs la bstod: bstod pa'o: thugs dkar nyi zla'i steng du hrīḥ yig la: gsang sngags snying po bar med 'du zhing 'phro: bdag zhan byas yang snying gcig ma bzla: hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥdzāb bzlas so: rang lus lda la sgrar grags sngags kyi sgra: dran rtogs sku lnga'i tin 'dzin rgya mtsho las: hrīḥyig ye shes lnga yi don la lta: stong gsal brjod bral rig sku mngon sum mthong: rdzogs rims so: hriḥ zag med tan tshagos kyi bkang zhing gshegs: bag chags 'khor ba'i 'grogs ma ra ya: tshogs phud cha gsum pa'o: hrīḥ rdo rje slob dpon bsgrub pa'i mche dang lcam: 'dod yon ma spangs longs rgyan du bzhes:

tshogs drang ba'o: hrīḥbadag dang dbyer med sku gsum don gyi lha: zag med bde ba'i zhal zas tshogs su rol: zhes blang zhing longs spya: ma nu sarba sā mā yābadzra tsitta hūṃ: smon lamo ma: lhag ma bsdus bran a ka ros brlabs la: hrī rang ngo ma shes rtog 'khyal sgrib can kun: phun dang dpal gyi phal gyi phal 'babs longs spyod rol: u tsiṣṭa'i sngags gyis sbyin no: hrīḥ thabs shes sgyu ma'i laha tshogs dbyings nas gzhengs: dug gsum dgrogs sku gsum klong du bzlog: bskul zhing bzlog pa'o: hrīḥthog med dus dang da lta ma 'ongs tshe: sku gnyis bde shegs spyan sngar rang mdangs 'khor: brjod bral blo bdas chos 'khor rtag bskor tshe: rig rtsal mkha' 'gro dam na khas blangs bzhin: 'khor ba ru log ye shes dbyings bsgrol ba'i: phrin las sgubs cig ma mo bstan ma'i tshongs: bka' dang dam las ma 'adha' sā mā yā: chad mod dang bstan ma bskyang ngo: hrīḥ chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i mkha' dbyings su: gnyis 'dzin rtog tshogs ma lus stam bha nan: mnan pa'o: hrīḥ zhi khro'i gar na 'khor 'das dbyings ye shes su bsgyur: skun rdzob 'khrul pa'i gdon tshogs thal bar brlog: lta bro'o: hrīḥ'adul byas kun rdzob don dam chos: thams cad byang chub chen po'i rgyur bsngo: bsngo ba'o: hrīḥ 'khor bas gnas pa'i dus ma sems can kun: ma lus tsham gcig sangs rgyas thob gyur gcig: smon lam mo: hrīḥ bdag dang dam tshig ye shes gnyis med lha: nam yang mi btang yun tu brtan par gyi: tiṣtha badzra sa ma ya hūṃ: gshegs bsdu'o: hrīḥsku gsum ye shes mi 'gyur don gyi lha: zhi dang khro gar gsang sngags rang sgra can5 thugs rje mkha' khyab ye shes dkyil 'khor gyis: khams gsum sems can kun la bde legs rtsol: zhes bkris brjod do: de ltar yang gsang gsang ba nyung bsdus pa'i las byang 'di ni padma bdag gis bkod: sku gsum bsgrabs thabs gsum gyis thems su bzhag:

da lta'i dus su gnod sbyin ming sring dang: ma 'ongasasha smin lam gcig pa'i bu la gtad: ha ra nag pos bka' 'di thub par bsrungs: dus la bab tshe las ldan bu la sprod: dus min len na de yi dbang po bsnubs sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: lha sras kyi phyag yin 'chong shog smug po'i ngos las 'bri gung bya bral bas: dus la bab par gzhu spro lugi skyed tshal du phab pa'o: gcig zhus/// / dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: gsang snying byang gi skor: thugs rje chen po phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thams: yi ge gcig ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so: 0000000: bcom ldan 'das dparal sku gsum 'dus pa'i lha phyag 'tshal lo: yang de'i tshe gnod sbyin ming srid dregs pa 'byung po dang bcas pas rang rang gi lus longs spyod dang bcas pa phul nas: 'dathi skad ces gsol to: rang 'byung mtsho dbus padma'i stong bu la: ya mtshan rmad byung padma'i rgyal por 'khrungs: mtshan mchog dod ldan padma sa bha wa: dus gsum mkhyen pa padma'i sku la bstod: bdag cagang sngon bsags bsod nams ldan pa yis: gu ru'i zhal 'jal gsang sngags gdams pa gnos rang gzhan smin grol bskyed rdzogs gdams pa ni: sngan chad ma gdang thugs kyi byang bu rtsal: bka' drin che de nas byang chub bar: dam pa khyed kyi bka' brgyud 'dzin par smon: slar zhu'i mdo don lha gcig sngags gcig gis: gzhan don mthar dbyung phyi nang gsang ba yi: bskyed rdzogs gdams pa ma lus gnang par 'tshal: zhes ni phyag btsal gsol ba 'debs pa la: padma bdag gis lan 'di smras so: kye ma gdon sbyin ming srid dregs pa 'khor: ma yengs gus pa'i yid kyi nga la nyen: phyi ltar 'phags pa'i thugs mchog byam pa'i sems: sems kun la bsgoms pas bzhan don 'grub: de yang bde ba'i bstan la bder 'dug ste: 'di ltar bsam bya rang nyid yang nas yang: 'khor ba'i gnas kyi srid par 'khor ba na:

sems can gcig gcig gis kyang rang gi ma: lan grangs mi mang bar byas pa la na: phan btags gnod skyabs drin ni bsam mi khyab: de lta'i tshe 'dir rang gzhan kun 'khrul bas: chags sdang rnam pa'i nye ring gang snang kyang: gong gi drin don dgra gnyen rig drug kun: ris med mnyam par bde bar gur rung gi: bsam pa rnam par thag pa yang dang yang: dran pa'i gsol gdab 'bad do bsgom par bya: des ni phyi nang dgra gdon bsam ngan zhing: kun gyi pha ma pho nu ltur mthong: rang nyid rgyud dul yul dug bde bar 'char: chos kun rtsa ba sbyams pa bsgom pa'i thabs: gzhan phan 'gro ba 'dul ba'i thabs rtsa ba: snying por gdams so dam par yid 'chong: zhes smras pas thams cad byams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur te: sā mā yā: 00000: de nas nang thugs rje chen po la yi ge drug gis gsol ba gdab pa 'di smras so: skye bo gnod sbyin ming sring la sogs pa'i: 'dir 'tshogs drigs pa'i tshogs rnams nga la nyon: dper na dbyar gyi chu bo'i rgyud lugs ni: dus su mi gnas 'phel 'grib 'byung ltar: dam chos 'byung yul rgya gar gnas yin kyang: ma 'ongs shāg thub bstan pa'i lhag ma ni: bod kyi yul du lan gcig gsal lam snyam: de dus da lta'i 'dir bstan mos rnams kyang: smon lam mthu yis lhan gcig der 'du te: spre'u tsha bod kyi 'gro ba 'dul ba'i tshe: bod kyi lha skal mgon po spyan ras gzugs: zhi bas bdul la sems dpa'i skur bston cing: yi ge drug gis thar pa'i lcang thag byed: chags chen ma lus byang chub gnas su 'dren: bod kyi mi ni gdug rtsug gasrin mo'i rigs: zhi bas mi thul lha srin 'byung po kun: de dag 'dul ba rta mgrin dbang ga lha: bar chod gdon bgod tshar gcod lam rab bston: de phyir lha gcig thugs rjes chen po la: lus ngag yid gsum mos pas gsol ba thob: de yang 'gro 'chags nyal 'dug spyod lab dang:

tshogs dang dben pa gang kyang mdun gyi mkhar: thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan sar gzigs: sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag kyang bzhi: dngas pa'i shel gyi ri bo bzhin du gsal: dang po'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar: tha ma gnyis kyi shel phring padakar bsnams: rin chen rgyan spras dar gyi na bza' klubs: rdo rje skyil dkrung padakar zla ba'i steng: lha me lha nge lha bas mchog mi shes: mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs 'gro la brtse bar bzhugs: bdag sogs rigs drug pha ma sems can kun: dga' zhing gus dang dang ba'i mdun pa yis: 'phags pa'i drung du thams cad tshogs par bsam: āoṃ ma ṇipadme hūṃ: zhes pa gsang sngags gzungs sngags snying po mchog: kun 'dus gsang ba'i yang snying dam pa 'di: 'brug gi sgra'i dbyar gyi char rgyun ltar: sgra bcas bar med bzla zhing ros 'ga' na: snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas yi dang spro bskyed pa'i: phan yon tshigs su bcod gsol ba gdab: 'phags pa'i sku las 'od sna lnga 'phros: bdag gzhan lus ngag yid 'phrog sgrib gsum sbyangs: 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs su dbyer med bsam: de bzhin bdag gzhan don phyir zhi rgyas dbang: mngon spyod las sgrub 'od zer kha dog bsgyur: mthar ni bdag gzhan 'byor med ngang nas bzla: 'khrul pa'i dri bral sangs rgyas sku gsum 'grub ngos don yin the tshom som nyi mod: de ltar gsol gdab yi ge drug ma 'di: lha ru gdams so yi dam skal bar zung: zhes smra pas: der 'khor pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa yi ge drug ma'i sgras 'ur gyis gang bar gyurato: sā mā yā: 00000: de nas yang gsang yi ge gcig mar bsgrub pa 'di smras so: skye ma gnod sbyin ming sring bdag la nyon: snyigs dus smon lam gcig rnams bod kyi yul: chu la 'khyag chags mtha' 'khob skye ba'i tshe: las ngan dbang gis bsdum rgyun chad med: 'on kyang rgyud bskul chos 'al mos pa mang:

de dus lha bsgom ting 'dzin mi gsal zhing: sngags bzla'i grangs rtags bsnyen pa tshad mi phyin: ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i rig pa rtsal shugs chung: de dus zhi lha 'dus pa spyan gzigs: lha gcig sngags ti nge 'dzin gcig ma 'di: nyams su blangs pas long spyod sku zhi ba'i lha: ma lus kun rdzogs gzhan don 'phris las 'grub: sā mā yā: de yang lha yongs 'dus sku: kun pa snying rje'i spyan ldan spyan ras gzigs: ye shes zhal gcig thab shes phyag zhabs zung: mtha' la mi gnas rdo rje skyil dkrungs bzhugs: g.yas pa mchog sbyin phyag gi pad stong dang: g.yon pa thugs kar bgrang phreng 'gren pa'i tshul: longs spyod rgyan rdzogs mtshan dpe 'dir 'bar: 'gro ba kun la byams pa'i thugs ldan bsgom: spyan drangs bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul : bstod cing bzlas la rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom: tshogs phud drangs blang smon lab gdab cing bsngo: bskul bzlog chan mod bstan bskyang mnan bro dang: bsngo smon gshegs bsdu shis brjod las gzhung bsring: de ltar rnam rgyud man ngag ltar bsgrubs pas: gong bzhin bdag don mthar phyir gdul bya rnams: mos gus rab 'du 'gro don phrin las 'byung: sā mā yāgatad gnod sbyin ming sring sogs: snod ldan kun la gtad do nyams su long: bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i gdung sol gcig bsgrub 'di: ma yongs lha sras rgya bu'i chos su bstan: de yang bzhi bcur nye dus sprul pa'i gzugs: mo long gzugs bsnyen lta bu shar ba'i tshe: nyams su langos la don gnyis mthar phyung gcig: gdams so gtad do dregs pa'i tshogs la gtad: dus min len na de yi po bsnubs:dus la bab tshe las ldan bu la sprod: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: lha sras kyis phyag yig 'chong shog smug po las: 'bri gung bya bral du ming 'dzin pas/ spro lung gi skyed tshal du dag par phab pa'o/// /
gcig zhus//

dam chos dgosangs pa yang zab las: gsang ba snying byang bdi bskor: rta mgrin phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs yi ge gcig ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so: 000000: bcom ldan 'das ska gsum 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshol lo: de yi tshe: gza' klu ming sring dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas rang rang gis 'byor ba'i longs spyod bsdus nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'askor te 'di skad ces gsol te: hūṃ 'khrul bral thugs ni 'od gsal dbyings su gsal: āḥgazhom med gsung ni rang byung mkha' las 'grog: āoṃ: 'gyur med skyed sku ni gdul bya'i zhing du 'bab: hrīḥsku gsum yongs rdzogs phrin las mdzad la 'dud: gsang sngags chos kyi sgo mo ji snyed kyang: mod bsdus dam pa ston pa'i bla ma nyid: bsnyan rten mchod bsgrub dam las ma 'khums na: ma 'ongs rtsub 'gyur drag po'i dus dang ni: dalta ma rungs tshar gcod slob dpon sku: bde shegs drag po khro bor sgrub pa'i thabs: sngon du ma bstan gsang ba'i thugs byang zhig: bdag cag rnams la bka' yi sgo dbye gsol: zhes gsol sgo gsum gus pas phyag btsal zhing: lus brtabs lan brgyar bskor te mol ba la: padma bdag gis lan du 'di skad smras so: gnod sbyin la sogs mi min dregs pa'i 'khor: khyed rnams 'di don zhu ba shin thu legs: lha yi ngo bo rdo rje slob dpon sku: 'di la dkyil 'khor ma 'dus gang kyang med: sngags kyi rang sgra gzhom med rdo rje'i sgra: 'di la snying po ma 'dus gang kyang med: ting 'dzin ngo bo mi g.ye 'gag pa med: 'di la ting 'dzinam 'dus gang kyang med: de phyir phyi nang gsang ba'i bsgrub thabs 'di: sem nyi spongs la tshogs dben rgyun du bsten: phyi ltar dpal ldan khro rgyal snying rje'i stobs: sems can kun la bsgoms pas dregs pa 'dul: rtsub 'gyur tshal lam dben gnas drag shul sar: ci bder gnas la 'di ltar bsam bya ste:

rang nyid srid du yang yang lus blangs tshe: da ltī ma bzhin dus kun phan btag pa'i: drin can 'gro drug 'khor ba'i ma rgan rnams: bde bar 'dod kyi bsdul rgyu la spyod: spyi khyab sems can 'di rnams snying ri rje: khyad du khar ltung 'gyur sdig can dgra: sdang dang gdug sems can gyi 'dre gdon bgegs: thams snying rje bsngal rgyun chad na: snyam pa'i bcos dang bcos min snying bsgom: des ni log bsdugs 'khyams dang 'khu ldom zhi: dmigs pa rno zhing yul gsal gang brtsams 'grub zhes gdams pas thams kun ngos shes rnying rjes 'chi ma 'khrugs par gyur to: sā mā yā: 000000: de nas yang de'i tshe na nang ltar khro bo rte mgril du bsgom zhing gsang glu blang ba 'di smras so: kye bo gnod sbyin ming srid la sogs pa'i: drogs pa can gyi 'khor tshegs bdag la nyon: de las bdag nyid khro lha kun 'dus pa: thugs rje pad 'byung khro rgyal dbang gi sku: spri'u tsha gdug can glang snyig dgra rnams dang: gnod sdang sems 'chang drag gtum 'byung po'i tshogs: de dag gdul phyir chos dbyings skye med las: 'gag med rang snang pad nyi dgra bgogs stong: a ya ghri wa ye shes dbang gi sku: 'bar ba'i me 'dra 'od zer 'phro zhing brjod: zhal gcig khro gnyen smin 'khyug rdzi rmang bskyod: rdzogs 'drel gachigs spyan dmar gyen du g.yo: zhal nas khrag 'dzag dbu skra dmar ser 'bar: phyag g.yas rdo rje thod dbyug dar dpyangs gdeng: g.yon pa thugs kar thod pa bdud bkang: dbu gtsug rta mog ljang zhur 'tsher zhing rngam thod skam dbu brgyan rlon pa'i do shal dang: stag sham glang gos sbrul chun g.yang gzhir bcas: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rgyan ldan gar dgus 'gying: g.yon nas 'khol ba'i rdo rje phag mo dmar: khro tshul chags bcas thod skam rin chen dang: rus pas brgyan cing gri thod yab la mkhyud:me long dril bu el kha'i 'khrol zhing:

g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum phag zhal skra grol ba:sgyur ma gzha' tshon chu zla lta ba'i ngang: snang stong lha sku ye shes gnyis med bsam: phyi nang snang ba'i tshogs la thog rdzis spyod: sgra grag thams cad hya ghri wa'i sngags: skye med rang sgrar mos pas rig ngar bcas: āoṃ hyaṃ ghri wa hūṃ: zhes pa'i sngags tshig brjod pa rab spangs pa: rim pa hur bskyed rig rtsal ngar ldan pas: smra ba'i rgyun bcad sna nas snang glu blang: ci shar byung dgag sgrub brul bar bya: bdag gzhan gnyis med dar 'dra'i lhar bsgom zhing: glu blang nyams bskyangs gtad med spyod pa bya: de yi snang sems rig pa'i spyod pa 'grub: snang ba sems rtogs 'khrul pa'i dra ba gcod: gnyid med rig pa'i dkyil 'khor 'grul par 'gyur: zhes smras pas: thams cad dag pa lha'i 'khor lo 'ba' zhig tu gyur to: sā mā yā:0000000: de nas gsang ba lha gcig sngags gcig gis bdag dang dgra gdon gnyis mde du la zla ba 'di smras so: kye ma dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs bdag la nyon: ma 'ongs dus mtha' snyigs mar thugs pa'i tshe: gsang sngags chos ni brag cha'i sgra ltar gyur: nyams len bsgom pa la kha'i na bun bzhin: nyams blangs 'bral bu chu la mar 'dod 'dra: ngal dub yid chad skyed lug 'gyur pa'i tshe: khro rgyal 'dus pa dbang chen kī la ya: lha gcig bsgom zhing gsang sngags yi ge gcig: bzlas pas mchog thun 'bral bu 'grub pa dang: ting 'dzin gc-ig bsgoms ye shes kun 'grub pa'i : thabs kyi gdams pa gsang ba 'di bstan to: sā mā yā: de yang las byang bzhung bzhung bsring dkyil 'khor dbus: 'khor 'das gsal rdzogs sna tshogs padma dang: thabs shes zung 'jug nyi ma zla ba'i stong: rang rig rgyal ba'i po dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku: drag po dbang chen sras mchog kī ra ya: tha'-ing nag rab 'jigs 'gyur med zhal gcig pa: gar dgu'i nyams ldan khro chas gzi brjed 'bar:

sku smad lcags phur zur gsum dbal dang bcas: drogs pa dgra bgogs gnad gyi snying gar gzer: phyag g.yas me'i 'khor lo dam mkhar 'phyar: g.yon pa lcags kyus dgra bdes snying nas 'dren: sku la ye shes spyan mig stong gis gtong gis gtams: ye shes mo dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs: spyan drangs bzhug gsol phyag btsal mchod cing bstod: bzlos pa bya zhing rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom: tshogs phud drang blang smon lam gdab cing bsngo: bskul bzlog chad mdo bstan bskying mnan bro dang: bsngo smon gshegs bsdus shis brjod las gzhugs bsrang: de ltar rnam gyur man ngag ltar bsgrubs pas: khro rgyal bde bar gshegs pa kun 'grub cing: bdag gzhan dgogs gnyis med la bzlos 'gyur: sā mā yā gtad dregs pa sngags bdag tshogs: ma 'ongs bzhi bcur nye dus lha sras skyes: mtha' 'khob kla klo'i yul khams 'dul ba'i chos: las ldan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i gsang tshig 'di: dus la bab tshe las ldan bu la sprod: =dus yin len na srog gi dbang po phrogs: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: lha sras kyi phyag yig 'chong shog smug po las: 'bri gung bya bral rlom pas: spro lung bdi skyed tshal du: dus la bab par phab pa'o/// / gcig zhus// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: gsang masnying byang gi bskor:kun 'dul bka' bsrungs gza' klu ha ra nag po phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa zhugs so: 000000: bcom ldan 'das dpal sku gsum 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: de nas gza' klu ming sting rtogs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pas: rang rang gi mthu dasung nus pa'i stobs kyis: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang: khyad par padma bdag gi bka' brgyud 'dzin pa'i bsrungs mar khas blangs dam bcas ste: rang rang rgyud bsgrub thabs man ngag du bcas pa so sor bsdebs nas phyogs tha dad pa rnams su gter du sbas so:

chos 'di nyid zhu bar gsol zhing gter sku bsrungs su smin lab btab pa'i: gza' klu ha ra nag po 'di ni: shin tu mi bsrun la drag rtsal dad ldan pa yin ste: de'i rlu mtshan kyang 'di nyid rigs 'tshol bar song bas: nam mkha' dang sa gzhir gnas pa'i dregs byed kun dang bsdong zhing: rnal 'byor dam tshigs can gyi grogs las: dam tshig nyams pa'i sngags mkhan ru tra kun gshed du che bas: slar la khos dbang byed cing 'tshun par mi nus pas: padma'i rgyud 'dzin gdams 'di nyid mchang ba'i pho nyar mngags so: sā mā yā: 00000: de nas bdag 'dre padmas: snying byang dmar po 'di'i bka' bsrungs phyi nang gsang bar bsgrub thabs man ngag dpab bcas pa 'di smras so: de nas nga ltar 'jig rten pa'i tshul du bsgrubs bas 'khor ba'i gzengs bstod pa ni: phyi snod kyi 'jig rten rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang: nang bcu kyi sems can thams cad ha ra nag po'i skur bsgom: sgrar grags tshad thams cad ha ra nag po'i sgra mos: 'gyuradran thams cad ha ra nams po'i sems can las gang du'ang mi rtog: de ltar sbyangs pas de nyid kyi rten dang rten par shar bas: 'gro ba gzhan 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang: ha ra nag 'dzin pa'i rtog pas gnyis su med par 'char ro: sā mā yā: 0000:gnyis pa nang btar ha ra nam po ye shes par bsgrubs bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i khungs dbyung ba ni: rang gzhan snang srid thams cad lhun grub rang snang rnam par dam pa'i gzhal yas khang du: thabs shes nyid kyi lha chen ha ra nam po'i skur mos pa na: de'i sku gsum thugs su 'gyur ste: rang gi 'jig rten pa dang ye shes pa'i tshul bsgrub pa'i blo las: ha ra nag po'i sku gsung thugs la snga phyir ngan pa dad dang bzang ba'i khyad dar med do: de bzhin du 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yang 'tshang rig pa ni: maya ngan las 'das pa'i khungs dbyung zhing: zhar la 'khor ba gzengs bstod par 'gyur ro:

sā mā yā: 00000:gsum pa gsang ba gnyis med ha ra nag por bsgrubs pas bar gcod rtsad 'byabs pa ni: chos nyid stong pa'i dbyings las: rol pa'i cho 'phrul du snang ba ni: dang por nyid drag po'i gnas su 'dug: drung dngos la mnags la brub khrung bca': nang du dam nyams byar ma'i rum pa gzhug: ram phye las byas dbal gtor sha khrag brgyan: brub khun steng bzhag bsgrub pa kho lhor bstan: rang nyid sris mchog kī la nam por bsgom: mdun gyi gtor ma mi dmigs gyur pa las: gza' klu me bsrun ha ra nag po ni: chu srin mgo can thog dang thod thun bsnams: mgo lus mig gang smad ni sbrul 'jug g.yo: kid kad sgra sgrog thod 'phred mi mgo dang: sbrul gyis rgyan can sprin rum me dpung 'bar: rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus nas thog ser 'bebs bdag gi bka' mnyan gsung bsten byed par bsam: 'di la bsrung 'khor zor bzlog bsad pa'o:dang po rang dang mdun bskyed thugs khar ni: hrī:ring hrī:thung dmar po 'phyod ltu: gcig las gnyis byung brgya tong khri 'brum bar: bsrung pa'i sa phyogs yul khams yul bdag zhun lus: phyi nang med par gang dmigs hrīḥ thung ni ya rkan lce sbyar bye ba gog bsnyen bya: hrīḥni nyam ma ya 'bum gzi dmar 'tsher rtsub: bzod klags med pa'i ra bas bskor ba'i mthar: rdo rje'i ra ba me dpung 'bar ba yis: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das dregs pa'i tshogs: gnod byed gang gis rlabs mi rnyed par bsam: 'phreng ba na du dgug cing 'dren par bya: zod ni zan bsrigs thal bar gzhi byas la: zangs lngags phyi bsre zhag gsum rab gnas bya: bsrung nas mgul gdags zor na phyog su phyag gtor: bsrung zhing bzlog pa'i dmigs pa gzhug bzhin bya: bzlog par 'dod na gong gi bcwa' bzhi la: thog mar hrīḥ bzas slags sgra 'brug stong ldir: lcags bsregs thog zer thog bcas thang la bam: byad ma lta bsrungs mi dang mi min dang:

byad byed bon sa bdag mi mthun phyogs: 'byung po 'dre gdon 'brub khung gnas pa la: phogs pas thams cad nag nyal btang bar gsam: sā mā yā: hrī:gnyis pa bzlas pas 'go gzhi lcags bsregs kyi: sa gzhi rab 'bar tsha la rtsub pa ni: tsha tsha 'phro ba bzod klags med par bsam: sā mā yā: hrīḥgasum brjod pas hrī: yi gi gu las: lcags kyu rab 'phros byad ma lha bsrangs bcas: gzugs can gzugs can med dkar nag 'tshams nas bkug: brub khung sa gzhi'i steng du brtabs par bsam: sā mā yā: hrīḥbazhi pa brjod pas hrī: yi khog pa las: sbrul zhags spros pas byad ma thams cad bcings: 'gul 'khyog med par 'bra khung bcug par bsam: sā mā yā: hrīḥlnga pa brjod pas hrīḥyi ta las: mtshon cha grangs med 'phros pas 'brub khung gi: byad ma lha 'asrungs thams cad myal myal btubs par bsam: sā mā yā: hrī: drug pa brjod pas hrī:yi tsheg drag las: ye shes me byung dgegs deg ni: bya sgro me la bsregs bzhin bzhin 'asregs par bsam: sā mā yā: hrīḥbadun pa brjod yas hrī: yi zla tshes las: las kyi rlung byang gzhob dang thal ba rnams: 'ub gyis phyags nas dmigs med dor bar bsam: gsang sngags snying po 'bru gcig bzla rab bya: bzlog bsad sngags la 'phreng ba phyir bskyur te: bzlos rtags spyi mthun ma byung bar du bzlas: 'dis ni dge bshes gdugs 'degs bla ma dang: gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇṭi ti yang rung: drod tshad phebs pa'i rnor dbang phyogs dang: mu rigs ngan sngags bon lo ldan sogs: byad ma gang dang 'gras kyang nyam mi nga: 'di ni skye bo dag gis shes gyur na'ang: lo bsgom zlas bshig zla bsgom zhag gsam 'jig: pha rol mthu mkhan dag dang gal bas chog: phur thogs stong gis brubs kyang kho rang 'jig:sā mā yā: bsad pa'i las ni ru pa'i snying kha ru: rtsibs brgyad hri:bri dbus ming rus rnam drangaḥl bskor: mthar ni byad ma'i ngag stam bha ma nan:

rang la sngogs byung rang 'dra yis: lcags mda' snying 'chin phug nas su: dug gi nus pa bachom par mos: gzhan la rang gis brdog par bsgom: sngags chu dang ni sngags kyi su: nus pa tshad na sngar dar 'dra: e ma: 'di 'dra'i dman ngag rin chen 'di: lcags kyis lcags gcod 'bigs pa bzhin: sngon tshe sangs rgyasasha 'khor lo che: 'das dus bstan la thub pa byon: de tshe log pa'i rgyal po ni: ma hā bhi ṣar mthu che bas: kun la zas nang dug sbyor byin: de tshe thub pas kho mtshungs pa'i: rgyal por sprul la phra dog pas: dus can zas kyi dga' ston bkye: de'i gnod pas rdzi med par: bkrag mdangs 'od kyi rdzu 'phul bstan: bha ṣa gnong zhing skyengs pa yis: sbyin pa'i 'bras bus ma 'ongs dus: yul gyi mar dug rigs kyi: bstan pa 'byung bar smon lam btab: thub pas dngos kyis ma thul kyang: yul der rgyal pa'i tshul 'dzin pas: dug rig 'joms pa'i byug sman sngags: gdams pa'i bdag por smin lam btab: yul ni kla klo mon gyi yul: rigs dang las kyi sbyor ba las: dug la spyod pa'i gling gcig yod: der ni bdag 'dri bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: phyin te mon bu bu spyi zlum sprul: rgyal po ma hā ra tsa la: gser phyi phul te gdams pa zhus: bka' dang gtor du ma spel kyang: nyams pa gso phyir 'di 'akod do: las ldan snying sems 'gro la brtse: skyes bu de dang 'di phrad shog: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gab rgya: bka' rgya: dam rgya: kha tham rgya: brgya dgus btab ste: dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi cha rkyen du bzhag pa'o: 'bri gung pa ratnas g.yu shog sngon po las dag par dben gnas 'brong ngur du phab pa'o/// / shu bhaṃ/ gcig zhus//

dam chos dgongs pa yang zab: 'chi med tshe'i skor nang gi dbang bskur zab mo bzhugs so: zangs shog dmar po'i chos sde'o: sā mā yā: 00000: 'chi med tshe'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dad dang ldan pa'i slob ma la: nang gi dbang bskur ba ni: rin po che dang sman 'bru dar zab snying gi nor phul ste: khrul bya bgegs bskrad mig dar bcang: me tog thog lo: phyi dbang ltar gsol ba gdab cing: dri ba dang lan ldon: slob dpon bdag nyid yab yum tshe bdag rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer 'phros pas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi bag chags thams cad bsrogs: rnam shes hri dmar por gyur pa zhal du zhugs dbu ma'i lam rgyud: yab yum gyi ba khar padma 'byung gnas bdag nyid du gsal ba phyir: gral du 'khor pa'i gnas gsum bdud rtsis reg la: 'khor la padma rdo rje: oṃ āḥhūṃ gi yi ge dang: sku gsung thugs kyi tshe lha rigs gsum dkar dmar sngo ba tshe bum longs sku brgyan can: rdo rje padma sems skyil gyis gnas par gsal ba'i gnas rnams las 'de ro so so'i kha dog can 'phros: nub phyogs bde ba can nas ye shes pa de ltu mang po spyan drangs: thim par mos shing: āoṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥgu ru sde na ḍakki ni ā yuḥdzñā na pa sa rin wa ra we sha ya ā a ā: zhes byin dbab: dbyir med du bstem: de'i don cos bzung la: tiṣtha badzra gyis brtan par bya: me tog yab yum gyi dbus su dor la: gang la nye ba'i ming gdag la ni: rigs thams cad shes gnyis su 'du ste: thabs yab la babs na: ḍā ki rdo rje bde lde rtsal: shes yab yum la babs na: ḍā ki padma bod mchog rtsal: zhes ming gdags: mig dar bsal: slob dpon yab yum kyi sku bsten la lha nga spod: de nas de la lha dbang bskur ba ni: slob dpon yab yum gyi lus dkyil du tshe bkug la: yab yum sbyar ba'i sku'am: zhabs la reg cing bdag slab du bzhugs:

tshe dgugs pa dang dbang bskur ba'i ni mtha' rten rnams phyi dbang ltar ro: sā mā yā: gcig zhus// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: 'chi med tshe'i bskor nyon mongs 'dod tshags rang grol gyi yig chung bzhugs so: 000000: nyon mongs 'dod chags rang grol gyi yig ge chung 'di kho na'o: e ma: nga yi gdams pa nyon mongs rang grol la: gces par dgongs pi rlung zab lag len ni: lha sras skye ba brgyud de chos 'di dang: phrad tshe nga dang mi gnyis tsha wa ri: rgya gar yul 'byung bsgrub pa'i rigs 'dzin bsnyes: do yi yang zab rmung gi gdams pa ni: 'chi med grub pa'i gnad kun lon 'gyur te: padma nga yi thugs rjes 'phrad pas long: stobs bskyed khams dang mthun pa'i sman sbyor ni: zab dgu bod 'dir 'byung bas gang 'phrod rten: nyams su blangs pa'i rtags tshad yon tan ni: byang sems rgyas pas lus kun bde zhing 'phar: lus kyi 'gul skyed thams cad bde bar 'bar: be stod ngang gis nyin mtshan 'khor lug 'gyur: lus la tsher ma zlag kyang bde bar 'bar: dngas ma rgyas te rakta 'o mar 'bab: bde bar gshegs pa'i lha sku ring sel 'khrungs: de ltar 'byung na nyams len zhen med bskyangs: rab 'bring mtha' ma'i rtags tshad brtson pas bsgrub: yang ni rdo rje las mi rung dang: padma shu thor tsha ba dang: sbyor snying mi 'od mgo rang ro stong na: yid mi bde zhing lta skyes gyur na: yab yum su la byung kyang bar chad yin: dam bshags stobs bskyed sman mar ril bu bsten: ngal gso tshed bzung brtson pas nyams len bya: galte snyigs ma gsang bar 'drel ba'i rtags: rig par gyur na yum gyi gsang rum du: sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad dbus dang sphyogs: rnams snang gor gyur rigs lnga tsho dpag med: yab yum gsal ba'i mkhar gtad bde mchod 'bul: ram tshig bdud rtsi mkha' las blang las blang zhing myang: rang lus 'chi med bdud rtsis bltams par bsam:

de ltar nyon mongs nyid kyis nyon longs kun: bla med byang chub mchog tu byad pa'i thabs: padma bdag las brgyud pa'i khong snying yod: rang nyid 'dod srid 'khrul phyir ma yin kyang: phyi rabs lha sras rgyal bu yid la bcags: kun las khyad 'phags zab khyad sngon byed 'di: nyams su lo cig pad 'byung bdag nyid la: yid dgengs chos shig kun gyi kha ma g.yem: bur sgog sha chang dri ma mi cig pa: sau ra 'byung ltar lha dang 'dren mthong mang: snying gi bu las su la'ang ma bstan cig: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gcig zhus// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: 'chi med tshe'i skor phyi dbang gnang zab tshe'i dbang bskur bzhus so: zas shog dmar po'i chos sde: sā mā yā: 0000: gu ru tshe dpag med la na mo: gnad zab tshe yi dbang bskur sbyin pa ni: slob dpon mchog la lo gsum snga gong nas: gsol bdag ba cing dbang gi zhu ba gsol: gnyis ma rtags tshad du phyin pa'i bla ma yis: phyi dbang bum pa'i gtor ma gnas su bskur: nang yab yum lus dkyir spyi bor bskur: gsang ba byang bdud rtsi'i bcud mchog smyang: thog mar phyi dbang bskur 'khor bskur ba yang ngo'i dus: mchod gtor ro tshe bum yo byad bta gon byi: bdag bum lhar bskyed bsnyen sgrub dbang blang zhing: slob bu khrus byas bgegs bskad bsrung 'khor bsgom: zhal du gda' zhing sku la reg 'dzim dang: thugs la bde ba'i dbang gi 'jug yon dbul: lag du me tog phreng ba thogs nas ni: kye ma: gu ru yab yum rigs snga tshe'i bdag: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba kun gyi sku: 'chi med tshe grub rig pa mchog gi mdzod: bdag la tshe yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: zhes lan gsum mo: bla mas lan sbyin pa ni: brtsod dus skal pa'i snyigs ma 'dir: 'chi med grub pa'i skal can ni: nyin skar tsam zhig mthong ba na: khyod nyid skal bar ldan nam ci: zhes dri: slob mas: bdag ni gsang ba dam pa'i snod:

log rtog the tshom dri ma med: gu ru yab yum thugs rje yis: bdag can brtse bar gzung du gsol: zhe gsum mo: de nas slob ma gu ru bdag nyid ni: longs sku dkar dmar tshe bum 'dzin pa: yab kyi sku'i nang du pad sdong brtsegs mar tshe bdag rigs lnga dang bcas pa bsgom la: mi bskyod tshe dpag med kyi thugs kar g.yu rung rigs dmar po'i 'od kyis: lho nub rnga yab gling pas padma 'byung gnas bdag yab yum gyi sku: tshe lha rigs lnga dang bcas pa mang po spyan drangs la bstim pa ni: byin dbab pa ste: snod du rung byas pa'o: de nyid brtan par bya zhing: ngo sprad de dbang bskur ba dngos ni: tshe zan: sa rmin te dang: swa bhā was bsang zhing sbyangs la: stong par bsam: de'i ngang las: tshe zan phyi dbyims gu ru yab yum dang: nang du tshe bdag rigs lnga rnams phyag na tshe bum dang: yab yum rnams mda' dar rang rang gi mdog can 'dzin pa: g.yon tshe bum can du bskyed la: yum rnams kyi mda' dar las 'od zer phros pas: tshe bkug cing lha so so'i sku dang tshe bum la bstims par dmigs: phyogs 'tshams steng 'og tu ma' dar g.yab cing: 'di skad do: āoṃ bcom ldan mgon po rnam snang tshe dpag med: yab yum gnyis med sku yis phro 'du las: 'gugs byed lha mo dkar mo'i pho nya 'phro: mda' dar tshe bum thogs nas stong khams nyul: bdag dang rtsa sbyor yon kyi bdag po y-i: tshe 'thor yal nyams yo lo gas 'khyoms ral zhing: phyogs skyong ste brgyad 'byung por sho ra re: sprul pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul stongs ma zhan: thugs rje'i rtsal gyis tshe dpal dbang du bsdus: 'chi med bum pa tshe rten 'di la khug: āoṃ bhūdha a yuḥdzñā na tshe tshe brum dza: hrīḥ bcom ldan mgon po padma tsha dpag med: yab yum gnyis med sku yi 'phro 'du las: smin bed lha mo dar mo'i pho nya 'phro: mda' dar tshe bum pa thogs nas rtong nyul: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yis:

lus bkrag drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams te: phyogs skyeong ste brgyad 'byung por sho ra re: sprul pa'i lha mo rdzus sprul rtobs ma zhan: me yi khams nas drod kyi bcud bsdus la: 'chi med bum par tshe rten 'di khug: hrīḥpadma āḥyu dzñā na tshe bhrum dzā: hūṃ:bcom ldan mgon po rdo rje tshe dpag med: yab yum gnyis med sku yi 'phro 'du las: bsdus byed lha mo sngon mo'i pho nya 'phro: mda' dar tshe bum thems nas stong khams nyul: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon yon gyi bdag po yi: lus mdangs khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams te: phyogs skyong sde brgyad 'byung por lus mdangs khrag sho ra ro: sprul pa'i lha pa'i mo rju 'phrul stobs ma zhan: mda' tsho bum thogs nas stong khams nyul: bdag dang rgyud sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi: gzugs phung sha dus khams nas tshe nyams te: phyogs bum skyong sde brgyad 'byung por sho ra ro: sprul pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul stobs ma zhan: pa'i khams nas bsro ba'i bcud bsdus la: 'chi med bub pa tshe brtan 'di la khug: tra ratna ā yuḥdzña na tshe bhrum dza: ā bcom ldan mgon po karma tshe dpag med: yab yum gnyis med sku ya'i phro 'du las: grub byed lha mo ljang gsal bo nya 'phro: mda' dar tshe bum thogs pas stong khams khang: bdag dang rgyu sbyor mon gyi bdag yo yi: sog 'dzin dbugs kyi khams nas dze nyams te: phyogs skye brgyad 'byung por sho ra ro: sprul pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul stobs ma zhan: rlung gi khams nas g.yo ba'i bcud bsdus la: 'chi med bum pa tshe rten 'di la khug: ā karma ā yuḥdzñā na tshe bhum dzā: zhesha bstim la: slob bu'i spyi bor bskar te: oṃ sku yi dbang gachog bhudha tshe dpag med: zhal cig phyag gnyis bde chen gnyam par sbyor: dkar gsal 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gsang rum nas: sku yi tshe dbang rab 'byam bskur du gsol: āo bhu dha a yuḥdzñā na tshe bhum hūṃ a bhi cam ñtsa āoṃ:

mgrin par dbang bskur te: hrīḥgasung gi dbang mchog padma tshe dpag me: zhal cig phyag gnyis bde chen mnyam par sbyor: dmar gsal 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gsang rum nas: gsung gi tshe dbang rab 'byams bskar du gsol: hrīḥpadma ā yu dzñā na tshe bhum hū?ṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ snying khar bskar te: hū thugs kyi dbang mchog rdo rje tshe dpag med: zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'de chen mnyam par sbyor: mthing gsal 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gsang rum nas: thugs kyi tshe dbang rab 'byam bskur du gsol: hūṃ badzra ā yuḥdzñā na tshe bhum hūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: lte bar bskur te: traṃḥ yon tan dbang mchog ratna tshe dpag med: zhal cig phyag gnyis bdon do mnyam par sbyor: ser gsal 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gsang rum nas yon can tshe dbang rab 'byam bskur du gsol: hūṃ:badzra ā yuḥdzñā na tshe bhum hūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: lte bar bskur te: traṃḥyon tan dbang mchog matna tshe dpag med: zhal cig phyag gnyis bdon de mnyam par sbyor: ser gsal 'chi med bdu rtsi'i gsang rum nas: yon tan tshe dbang rab 'byam bskur du gsol: traṃ ratna ā yu dzña na tshe bhum hūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ gsang bar bskur te: phrin las tshe dag rkar tshe dpag med: zhal gcig phyogs gnyis bden mnyam bdon de mnyams par sbyor: ljang gsal 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gsang rum nas: 'phrin las las tshe dbang bar 'byam bskur du gsol: āḥ karma sam yuḥdzñā na dze bhrum hūṃ a bhin ci īḥ: zhes rgyas nag sku bcas te dbang te dbang bskur ro: lha rnams kyi bum pa nas bdud rtsi bas pas gu ru yab yum gyi sku gang ste: sbyor 'tshams dang bum pa nas bdud rtsi bas:slob bu'i gnas so so'i lha rnams kyi bum pa nas bdud rtsi bab pas gum ru yab yum gyi sku gang sku ste: sbyor 'tshams dang bum ya nas bdud rtsi bab: slob bu'i gnas so so'i lha rnams kyi bum pa gang zhing lhud pas:

lus gang: sgrib pa lnga dag: ye shes lnga thob: sku lnga mngon du byas par bsam zhing: ngo sprad do: de nas tshe chang dang: tshe'i pu lu tshe bstim pa yang: tshe'i sngags kyis sbyin zhing brtan par byo'o: rjes rgyas gdab pa ni: bhū ye shes lha mo tshe mdag bsrung ba'i lha: snang tshoms mdom can rin chen:rgyan 'chang ma: 'khor lo padma rdo rje rin po che: rgya grim 'bar phyag rgya bar bkra bas: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag gyi bdanag po yi: tshe srog lus zungs dbang thang rlung rta'i stobs: phyi nang bar chad mi mthun rkyen rnams las: yongs su bsrung shig badzra raksha bhrum: zhes tshe mda' gnas so sor gtugs shing sbyin no: lus dang long spyod gtang rag tu dbul: slob gyis lha la mchod sto mchod stod nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing lha chad bskang: shis pa brjod: dog ba byang chub tu bsngo ba rgas btab po: e ma ho chod sku snang ba tha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs: de 'i drang du padma bdag nyid kyis: lus dang longs spyod ltos med mchod yar phul: 'chi med tshe phyi dbang 'di zhus te: nyams su blangs bas skye 'chi med pa'i lus: rdo rje'i lus 'di grub po phyi rabs rnams: 'chi med 'dod na lus dang long spyod bcas: 'phangs med dam pa rje la phul nas ni: 'chi med che'i bdud rtsi 'di la spyod: snying la chongs cig sa ma ya a tham rgya: 'chi med gsang ba'i phyi dbang rdzogs so: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: gnyen rgya: zab rgya: rgya lnga btab dgongs pa yang zab kyi 'tshi med bsgrub pa'i gnang du gdams so: e ma 'di nyid zab chog ga ste: ma 'ongs lha sras byang chub sems dpa' yi: 'gro 'dul tshe yi bdag skur 'di la gyisas: 'di nyid yang zab gnad bsdus phyogs rtsam bstan: 'di la dgos pa'i tshe yi las gzhugs dbang rgya par byed na 'grol ya'i sgron me sbor: nga yi bu mchog lha sras snying la phur:

sa ma ya: kha thaṃ: nang dang gsang ba'i tshe dbang logs su bag: maṃ gda lam: ma med pa'i gdung 'dzin pa: bod chos skyong pa'i lug gnyis kyi chab srid dar zhing rgyas ba bya ba'i rtan 'brel du 'bri gung bya bral bas dag par bris pa'o: bkris: ral rtsa brgyuong yung du sbo bar 'gyur ro: sā mā yā: phag sha ho: rgya rgya rgya: 0000:yang dgro bo myur du bsar pa'i thabs la: g.yag dung lin du: btsan dug 'bri tshil ma de leb kyis brgyungs pa mtho 'ong tsam bzhug: de'i khang dgra yi dri chen rlon pa zel mor bcos pa bzhug: de'i khang sbur pa ko ko yag dri za ba de bzhug la: rja' shing gis kha dam par bced: klu btsan klu bdud nag po gnas nges pa'i gnas su sbas na: sbur pas dri ma zaus nas bcan dug zos pa dang: dgra bo de na nas 'chi bar 'gyur ro: babs na de'i gong du sbur pa 'don no: sā mā yā: phag sha ho: rgya rgya rgya: 00000000: dam dgra bu med bsad pa'i thabs la: ra gang yang rung ba'i nang du bud med de'i chu shul gyi sa blug: de'i khar stig pa gson po gcig bcug pas: sdig pas de zos pa dang bud med de 'gum mo: man ngag zhal shes yod sā mā yā: phag sha ho: rgya rgya rgya: 00000: spra tshil bag zan gang rung la: bud med de'i gzugs mtshan ma can bya'o: rkang rjes dang chu shul gyi sa mtshan mar blug: de'i khar bul tog blug: leg sbe gzugs de gzugs de bcug: des sdig pa gcig bcug la kha dam par bya: 000000000: babs na 'don no: skyes pa la byed na gzhan gong dang 'dra'o: pho mtshan nang du rjas blug: sdig pa bzhug pa dang: don gong dang 'dra'o: sā mā yā: phag sha ho: rgya rgya rgya: madgalam: gcig zhus: thugs kyi byin rlabs mchog rtsol 'phris sgrub: rtsa sngags kyi shma bur tsita a bha ṣiñtsa hūṃ: zhes brjod rang srogs thugs las 'od zer 'khros: slob ma'i lus la thim rig stong ngang du bzhag: skad cig ngang las rlung 'tshub 'khyil ba'i dbus:

skyis bu dam can drangs gzhung rjogs par bskyed: gnas gsum byin rlabs de las 'od 'phros pas: 'u'u yug lcags mkhar gnas nas spyan drangs bstim: rtsa sngags sham bur bur a bhi sha yas dbab:gtor ma sku rten bcas pa spyi bor bskur: tri: sprul pa'i zhing khams kun snang gzhal yas nas: ye shes dbyings las 'gro don skur bstan pa: dam can skyes bu badzra thig le rtsal: drag po'i zhal gyis sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs: zhi ba'i na bzas bar mchad rkyen rnams sel: rdo rje ru dar bla med yang gsang 'dzin: sprul pa'i theg pas stong gsum yud kyis bgrod: thugs rje zhags pas log lta'i snying nas 'dren: dur khrod chas gsol dgos 'dod yid bzhin stsol: skye bu dam can rdo rje legs pa yi: sku yi byin rlabs mchog stsol 'phrin las bsgrubs: tri badzra sa du tri li dza dza: kā ya a bhi shiñtsa oṃ: zhes mgrin par bskur zhing 'di skad do: tri gzungs sngags snying po drag po'i rang sgra can: dpal gtum rab 'jigs rngam byed mi bzad pa: rno dpal tshan can srog gzir sngags kyi dbang : gsung gi byin rlabs mchog stsol 'phrin las bsgrubs: gang bzhin sngags kyi 'jug tu: waka a bhi shiñtsa a: zhes dang bzlas pa'i rjes bzlos ci rigs bya: gtor ma snying gar gtug cing 'di skad do: tri sna tshogs 'gro 'dul thabs kyi dang shes nas: mi dmigs cho 'phrul du mar sku sprul pa: dam can skyes bu ging gi tshogs rnams kyi: thugs kyi byin rlabs mchog stsol 'phrin las bsgrubs: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur: tsita a bhi shiñtsa hūṃ: zhes brjod dam can thugs las 'od zer 'phros: slob ma'i lus thim gsal stong dang du bzhag: des ni bka' bsrungs rnams kyi gtor dbang rdzogs: dam tshig bsrungs bar khas blangs btang rag btang : rnor mtshon ngar ldan mtshon cha yon du dbul: bka' srung nus pa'i rten 'brel 'di yis mtshon:

dngos po rdzas kyi sags thabs ni: ra dug ges zho btsan dug dang : chu rtsa thar nus sre ma'i brun: padma nag po ma nyid na ser khra'am dmar khra'am 'tshal dkar dang : chang rgod sbyar la ling ga bri: tha ma sngags kyis bskor bar bya: dpral bar rus ma nas na gha bha rna dza la snying gar ming : phu shul 00 'grub khung gsum bya: ro sol dug khrag gis byugs te: nang du gling ga gan rgyal du: mgo ni rang la bstan te bzhag: steng du gong gi rdzas rnams dpungs: za khab sor bzhi snying gar gzugs: gla ba shing gi grang phring byas: dngos med par mig gi gang : rag gtum gzi brjid ldan par bskyed: sa bsros nas ni nub bar du: zhag po gcig gi sngags 'dis brab: ra hu la tri dung dung lā dza dza : dgra bo che mo ma ra ya: thum thum rnī la sbad dam nyams 'di la la rus ba stus: nyungs dkar nyungs nag skye tshe dang : gong gi rjes rnams bsres byas te: lcags kyi thur mas gzugs la rdeg: grub rtags zhun dri dri tshil tshil dang : ra gzhog gnam zhing rang nyid kyi: dpral ba 'thug kob lus sbrid 'byung : de dus nga ro dmod bcol dang : ma nyes dpang gzugs shar mang gdab: brang brdung 'od dod 'bod par bya: de yis dgra bo'i bya ba rdzogs: rje kyi las 'jug bstan pa ni: ling ga rdzas dang bcas pa nyid: dam nyams de yi dug yin pas: dril te sngon dmar skud pas bcings: gza' rus 'gyu dus ma nor bar: tshas bcas dgra bo'i kha smang mnan: lcags srog yod kyang 'char par nges: rā hu la'i gsang bsgrub 'di: bzhin dang mi 'dra khe nyen che: zhag cig ma nyid dgra de phung : gnyid log smugs na rang 'chi bas: 'di rtsams la sdod thabs med: zhes sdang drag po'i ngar ldan pas: the tshoms bskyed du mi rung ngo : 'di ni ral gri phung rdeg yin: glo bur gsod par gdon ma za: rang las gzhan du spel srid na: 'dra min chos cig nga yi bka': dngos 'di spel thabs med do bu:

sā mā yā rgya rgya rgya zab rgya gter rgya sbas rgya gsang rgya dam rgya mar bskos : dam med len na dbang po bsnums la ldan de'i 'phrin las bsgrubs: ra hu ma na raka na: lcags shog sngono las bya bral ratna'i 'bri gung spro lung gi skyel du bris so: zhus// //

'khor skyu 'dod yon lnga'i rdzas bzhi pa'i gtor bzhong dka' pa lar: dpal bshos dam tri rgyu tra'i snying : 'khor skyu sha khrag nang grol rdzas lnga pa'i gtor gzhong drag po'i homs dpal bshos nad
