da ni 'gro gyi mtshan nyid bzhi zhes bshad/ srid gzhu'i 'gron ni dmigs skar mda' lta bur songs nas ni/ byad ma 'khor bcas brlag par bsam/ gong bzhin zor gsum bod na thems/ nyi shu rtsa cig zor rdzogs nas/ byad ma 'phung bar the tshom med/ de lta bu'i gsung bzlog mchog byad bla tshigs chung yang zab ni/ skal ldan der rtsam ma gtogs pa/ gter kha mang du rtsal ba med/ phyi dus lha sras rgyal po ni/ phyi nang bdud sprul nag po dang*/ mthu rtsal 'dran pa'i dus su dgos/ snying las stim mo a tham rgya/ sā ma ya rgya/ rgya rgyaragaya/ gter rgya sbad rgya zab rgya bsang rgya bka' rgya dam rgya lcags shog slon po las ratna 'bri khung spro lung gis bskyid 'tshal du phabs pa'o/ zhus dag go bkris dpal 'bar 'dzam ling rgyan shog ༄༅// gnod sbyin gyi yig chung*/ 'grol na gnod sbyin gtor ma ni: a tsar dmar por bskyed byas la: gtor dbang bskur zhing 'di skad brjod: hūṃ rā ma tshal gyi gnod byin che: rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' sdod khyod: phrin las bcol ba'i mthu byung gis: de ni bdag la 'tshe ba yis: dgra bo yin kyang 'bangs su mchis: bdag gi dam las ma 'gal na: de ring nyid nas dus bzung ste: nga yi 'bangs su mchi pa na: 'di la gnod 'tshe ma byed par: mgon skyabs bsrungs ma dam par: nya bo'i nang bcug e nang stsal: sngon dmar byad bcings steng du drang : lho nub gza' la shar lhor ma: shar du dam can gtor ma la:sna mo gtad do gnyer bcol bya: brub khung steng rtsa gsum gyi: gtor ma bzhag pas 'khu mi nus: khrag yung rdo rje dug mtshan thun bapag: lcags nag po ngar ldan bcang: rang nyid rtsa gsum phyag rtor ram: rta mgrin gang rung gsal ba'i gis gang: gza' bdud dmar nag rtar hu lha: mgo dgu mi lus sbrul 'jug can: mog lus med pas mig gis gang: phyag gams nyi zla phyar zhing rtog: g.yon pa spru gris srog gcod: gdugs pa sgrul gyi rgyan cha can:

sprin rum me dpung klong nas rngam: g.yon da ma mo 'khros mi ma'i rgyal: sngags bdag smug nag mche ba gtsigs: ru lu'i sgra sgrogs mig cig ma: g.yas pa dgra snying dmar po 'gro: g.yon pa thod khrag dmar la rol: brang la nu cig bdag la ston: mdun du dam cad thig le rtsal: dmar smug g.yas la rdo rje: g.yon pa ru dar snying zhags 'dzin: dar dkar bde gyon ra la zhon: bdu ma mon gyi snyag zhu gsol: 'khor du snang srid drog pas bskor: bdag nyid gi c-i bcol las byed bsam: rtag po'i sngags 'di zhag gsum bzlas: e ru ru e ka tsa ti snying khar su lu su lu hūṃ bhyo hūm̐ dza dza: badzra sa du tri ling dza dza: hī shag ru rag ram: na bdi tsi ta trang: ma ma za 'aghri: ha dhi ka sha la ke ta ke ta dza dza : dgra bo'i dbugs la rngam: sra sbriḥtriḥturaḥthum dza dza: yab chod ram gtor tshe srogatung tung kham kham phaṭa: de ltar bzlas shing bsgrub pa'i bar mchod gtor dus bzhir 'ag cing bskul:rtags ni bud med gar 'bad gar byed 'khrob: ban sngags mi ring g.yag rog 'khor: 'od skra khyim 'tsheg nyams dngos 'byung: rtags ma ma gsal bar 'bad po ces: de nas rang nyid khro mor bskyed: gza' dang sdor logs g.yas g.yon bsgom: las mkhan sde brgad ma lus bskyed: gsang sngags god ma zhag gsum bzlas: bsad rtags byon song bsad dang gtubs: g.yul shom dmag 'khrul mtshan cha thogs: 'khrul pas rang rgyal cho 'khrul 'byung: de la 'dzigs skrag mi bya bar: ngang sair sha tshil sgo nga bsreg: rang gi spyin bor phyag rdor rtan: de nas bcwa lnga'i nyid nub khar: mo nyes dpang gzugs lha dang phral: gsang sngags stong las thun gyis brab: gri mtshon de yis ling ga gtub: rnam shes rton phral rang la bstim: tsho bsod sdus la dbyings bsu sba: de nas zhag gsum sngar bzhin bzla: de nas dngos su rtags kyang 'byung: ling ga dug shing mer bsrogs te: zhal gdab thal sol ru par bcas:

gzhi mod klu gnas gnyin par gtad: gtor ma gsum ni 'gyur phyogs bstun: dgro yi khang khy-im phyogs su 'phang: bgrubs shul mi mngon brdul phyags gdab: mchod bstod gsol kha dag la 'bad: bla rda rje spog mcho byar mod de: dam tshig bgrubs tsho nad mi gos: dom mdze yugs sogs grib la la 'dzem: bud med 'atab dang nyal so spangs: de lta gsangs te bgrubs spyod na: ma ltar byams shing sring rtal gdungs bskul na las myu ra 'khu ldom med: bcu bzhi dag las phyir mi 'gying: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gab rgya: gsang rgya: dam rgya: bka' rgya: gnyan rgya: rgya dgugs gdabs ste gter du sbas: lcags shog sngon pa'i ngos las 'bri: gung pa ratnas spro lung skyed du dag par phab pa'o: dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: gnod sbyin mo dpun gsum gyi bka' gtad yod: 'di'i bka' gtad bya ba ni: bcwa gzhi gong ltar slob dpon bdag mdun gyi bsnyen pa rjogs nas: slob ma khrus nas phyung: bgogs bskrad ma dhal phul: me tog dang bcas gsol ba gdab pa ni: sangs rgyas kun dngos gu ru rje: sangs rgyas la mchog sgub pa la: sbyin dang bsod nams tshogs bsags phyir: gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro'i bka' gtad 'tshal: zhes lan gsum zhu: slob ma rtsa ba gsu gang rung du bskyed pa la byin dbab: sku rten dang bla rdo slob ma la gtad cing: mkha' 'gro ma dpun gsum dngos su blta: 'di skad do: āoṃ rdo rje:sku 'i ḍakki ma: slob ma 'di la gtad pa yis: gos kyi drung ngos ba rtsa la du gsol: āḥ tshang dbyangs gsung gi ḍakki ma: slob ma: bza' btung zas kyi dngos grub rtsol: hūi yidabazhin thugs kyi ḍakki ma: slob ma: nor 'bu longs spyod dngos grub rtsol: zhes dang: āoṃ i ling ki: pi ling ki: ki ling ki swāhā: karma sidha pha la ho: zhes lag tu gtad: sngags kyi rjes bzlos bya zhing su sra tiṣṣas bstan par bya'o:

gtor ma longs spyod kyi tshogs rgya chen por dmigs mi la tshogs su rol: sku rten slob ma la st-im zhing: bkris rjod: bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o: 'di 'i dam tshim tsig tu: bud med la mi dmod: de la snyas par mi bya: mo mtshan la ched du mi blta ba rnams ni dam tshig go: srog la rgyun bsnyen du bya ba ni: āoṃ tsha me ni: u me na: du kha than swāhā: zhes bzhi brgya ro tsam bzlo: des dngos gyub du myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro: 'di ni rigs 'dzin kun kyi khol: bsgrub sdo dgu yi bran mo ste: snying nye las myur gzhan pas phags: de phyir ma 'ongs nga yi bu: mi rgyu rju ba de la sprod: bka' gtad dam tshig rgyun sngags gsum: gsang ba'i gab yig lkog tu chongs: sā mā yā: sā mā yā: sā mā yā: 'chong shog smug po'i chos sde las ratnas chos kyi rgyal po'i phring chen po bu du phab pa'o: gcig zhus: dam chos dgongs pa yang zab: gnod sbyin mo dpun gsum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs su: 00000: rtsa gsum lha la phyogs 'tshol lo: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas gyis: dur khrod gsang chen rol par ni: ye shes mamakha' 'gros byin gis brlabs: las kyi mkha' 'gros grub byin: 'jig rten mkha' 'gros phris bsgrubs: de tshe stong gsum kun nyul ba'i: gnod sbyin chen mo sha za ma: mchod gsum las mkhan sprul par bcas: dngos su byon nas dam bcas pa: phyi rab brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi phyir: zasha dang gos dang nor gyi ni: dngos grub myur du 'grub pa yi: mthu rtsal nus mthu khyod la 'bul: zhes pa'i rang dam rang gis bcas: srog snying phul nas dam la gtags: de nyid bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i thabs: dam chos spyod pa'i cha rkyain du: gcos par gdams so snying la gnyogs: sā mā yā: sha za'i mkhro gnod sbyin mo: mchod gsum sgrub la don lngas bstan: dang po rtan gyi bca' thabs ni: ro ras pa ya shin shun gur gum chus byugs:

de gtso mo sku mdog mthing: g.yas su rjang mo g.yon dmar mo: thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis te: g.yas rnams dgastas bgegs tshal gcod: g.yon ma thod pa ratnas bkang: zhabs rnams g.yas bkyang bskums: padma utpal steng bzhugs shing: rin chen rus rgyan nam bzas mdzes: zhi zhing 'jum mdangs dbu sgra 'khyil: nu ma 'bur zhing gzhon nu'i tshul: rang byung tsakta bu mo gtsang ma'i sin dhu ra: gur gum tsan ldan dmar dkar: yang na gtar bu mo gtsang ma la dang shi ba'i khrag: rdzas lnga dag ni tshon la bsre: mtshon gyi 'og tu gsang sngags bri: de ltar tshon rdzogs bris sku de: mis ma mthong bar bya ba bcos:gnyis pa lha bskyed bsnyen pa ni: mdun du stegs batshan ga dhal bcwa: dbus su 'dab brgyad tshel 'bru'i bkod sku rten dbus bkod ba ling gsum zur gsum: shing thog dang ni sha sna khrag: dkar dmar zaba' btung ji snyed bsag: bde ba'i stan bdug skyebs sems dang: khyad par gnod sbyin dpun sgrubs nas: 'gro ba'i dbul 'phong bsal bar bskyed: rang lhar gsal ba'i mdun du ni: sku rten gtso 'khor gsum ldan bskyed: yig 'bru gsum byin brlabs cing: snying gi 'od kyi lho nub 'tshams: bsgoms pa tu spyan drangs stims: bdag bka' nyan las byed bsam: dang po'i sngags ni 'di yin no: oṃ a na le kun dha li ghri nas piṇa ddha pi shā tse ni ye swā hā: zhag bdun sgrubs pas gsung gi lha mos: zas kyi gangos grub ster b.ri byed: gnyis pa'i sngags ni 'di yin ste: āoṃ i lung ki: pi ling ki: ki li ki: sa shā tsi na ye swā hā: zhag bdun bsgrubs pas sku'i lha mos: gong kyi dngos grub ster bar byed: gsum pa'i sngags ni 'di yin te: āoṃ na mo shu tra mu tri ma hā si shā tsi na ye swā hā: zhag bdun bsgrubs pas thugs kyi lha mos: nor gyi dngos grub lter bar byed: gsum pa bla dho bzung ba ni: kṣar pa ni sbrum ma gsum:

byod ru mu men mu tig gsum: dar dmar sgrub tsho tsa mi'i rgyab du gdags: tril te sku dang bcas: mchang khung g.yon du bcas bar bya: bzhi sa thun 'tshams gtor ma ni: gtor ma byin rlobs bdud rtsir bsam: mdun gyi lha mo gsum pa lo: āoṃ i ling ki: pi ling ki: ki ling ki: a na le: kun dha li: ghri hna sin dha li pi na tsi na ye: na mthu kra mu tri mu hā si shā pashā tsi na ye i dam bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lam gsum gdi sngags kyis dbul: la sha pa'i mkha' 'gro mchod gsum gyi: gtor ma bzhes la bdag gzhan kun: byub sgrub pa'i grogs kyi phyir: sbyin dang bsod nams tshogs kyi rdzas: grub pa'i mthun rkyen dngos grub rtsol: dur khrod nams tshal shing drung chen po ru: lhag par gnas bcas sha za mkha' 'gro gsum: sgyu ma'i skur ston 'phis sgrub pa'i lha: sna tshogs mtshad pa yid bzhin nor 'dra chen zhing: dpag bsam shing ltar dgos 'dod re ba bskong mi zad gter gyi bum bzang mdzod 'dzin pa: dgos 'dod mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhes pa nā ga rdzu nas stod pas bstod: lnga pa las sbyor rgyun spyod pa: bza' ba'i dus su byang sems bcas: phud kyis mchod cing cing rag gi mdun: dbul su thugs kyi lha mo mthing: g.yas sku rjang zhing g.yon gsung dmar: kun kying zhal gc-ig phyag gnyis: g.yas na nor bu'i bum pa 'dzin: g.yon na yid bzhin rin chen bsnams: zhi ba'i 'jum zhal brkying bskum tshul: padma rin chen gdan la gnas: rus sa dang ni ren chen brgyan: sgrub pa so sha dgyes tshul du: ji ltar bsam pi don bsgrub bsam: zan chang dang pos sngags bdun bdul: oṃ i ling ki: si ling ki: ki ling swā hā: ghri hna siṇa pi shāe swā hā: bzlas shing sa la bor byas te: chos kyi grogs su gsol ba btab: de ltar bsnyen pas grub ba'i rtags: skyes pa dang ni bud med kyis:

rang la bskyen bskur byed pa dang: lo legs brtswa zhing 'bru 'char 'bebs: rin chen bter snyed la sogs pa: dngos sum rmi lab nyams su 'byung: de nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin: rang rang grub pa'i 'bras bu ni: 'byung 'gyung 'di la the tshom med: sha za gnod sbyin mkhro gsum: khol mod sgrub pa'i yang zab 'di: kun la spel bar mi bya ste: rigs 'dzin sgrub pa'i cha rkyen du: padma bdag gis khol bur phyung: lha sras rgyal bu'i phar nyar shog: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gab rgya: gnyan rgya: gtad rgya: rgya mdun gyayi btab ste: 'chong shog smug po'i sdebs su lha sras bdag gis bris so: sbrul lo la bu tshal pho brang du dag par phal pa'o// gcig zhus//

dam chos dgongs pa yang zab: bka' bsrungs lcam dral gyi srog gtad dang dam bse snying gi khrang ting ces bya ba bzhugs so: bka' bsrugs gasrum gyi srog gtad cing dam bsre ba ni: dam ldan snying dang 'dra ba las ma spel gcig: sā mā yā: khaṃtha:khaṃtha:khaṃtha: 'di kha na'o: 'di kho na'o: gtor la bca' gzhi gong bzhin la: ching dang rakta ratna te: a mri tas bran snod du blug: gtor ma gsum gyi dbus gyi dbus su bzhag: dri nas slob mas gsol ba btab: rig 'dzin gco bo drags sngags bdag: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir: ma mo 'di na ye ki ca ti ral shu ma: dmar smug phyag gnyis snying dang thod phrag 'thung: zhal nas tshegs gcig ljags 'dril 'khrug: dasral na spyan gcig dus gsum gzigs: brang na nu gcig 'dud di 'dzag: zhabs gcig stong gsum skad c-ig bskor: rang 'dra'i 'khor gyis bskor bar bsam: gnas rnams yig ges mtshan pa las: 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drags thig: āoṃ ā: hūṃ zhes brgya ca bzla: de nas gsang ba'i dzā ba 'dis bskul: e ru ru e ka tsa ti snyid kha rag rgyu lu bhyo hūṃ dza dza: bzlas pas stong gsum srags sgrags gang: bdag dang sems can khams gsum thams cad kyi: lus ngag sgrib pa yongs phyang zhing: 'dod chags las gyur rtog tshogs sbyangs: kun du bzang mo'i ngo bor bya: snod bcud zha'akhor rang la bsdus: rag gcig mkha' la gtar de dnges: bskyed pa'i rdzogs pa he ma ho: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa a nur bsgrub pa'i thabs: srid gsum rnam dag padma dang: zhi ba'i 'ching gcod nyi ma'i dal: gnyis 'dzin bralasha ba'i bam gyi ste: bdag nyid smug mkhros ma ni: ral gcig bla ma ku tu bzang: spyan gcig rgyal 'dus pa'i ku: tshel gcig yang snying yig ge bhyu: nu gcig zhi ba gsang chen lta: thabs shes gnyis ldan phyag mtshan bcas: zhabs gcig 'khros thogs med rgyu: ye nas lha dang gnyis med pas:

rang nying grub nas lha nyid rdzogs: rang dang lha gnyis dbyer med pas : spyen rgyangs mchod bstod bya mi mtshil: bdag stogs mtshan 'dzin 'joms: wal tsam pal tsam yin tsam ngu: gsang sngags bhyo yis gnyis med brtan: de gas nas 'khor bdas kun: rdo rje khro mo'i skur gong bzhin: dbyir med bstan la dzāb kyis bskul: bdag nyid bsdus la ngang du bzhag: rdzogs pa'i rdzogs pa e ma ho: sā mā yā: gsum pa rdzogs chen tshul bsgrub pa: rang ri dbyings ye shes 'di: yab yum chen khros ma rag gdong ma: 'khor 'das kun gyis klugs mi rnyed: ral gcig rtog tshogs dbyings su gcig: spyan gcig 'gag med rnams gzigs: tshems gcig srid zhi kun la rol: nu gcig 'khor 'das bskyed pa'i ma: zhabs gcig rdzu 'phrul kun dang ldan: de bas snang srid 'khor 'das kyang: rang rig yab yum chen nyid las min: ma cig don la mi 'da' na rgyu dang rkyen du dbye bar med: las dang 'bral bu gnyis su med: chags dang chags bral gnyis su med: sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med: du mar snang kyang dbyings kyis ngang: chos nyid las ni 'da' mi 'gyur: de ltar yen ni shes rig dum rtogs nas: sgom par byed byed sgom bya med: lha med sngags kyi yod min te: rang rig dang nas spyan cig dbyi: nam mkha' las ni nyi shar bzhin: ye shes snang ba lam me ba5 'od zer chen po kun nas 'bar: gsang sngar bdag mor phyir gsal te: sku dang ye shes mthar phin nas: bar do med par lhag me 'grub: rdzogs chen sang rdzogs e ma ho: dpal lngags kyi bsrungs ma ye shes par grub pa'i rdzogs rim dgongs pa'i snying byang ngu gdams pa'o: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: ma ning gza' yi rdzogs rim gsum: dang por bya ba gong dang mtshungs: dngos gzhi snod ni me rung 'khyil: char spran glog 'gyu'i dkyil 'khor dbul: bdag nyid ye shes rā hu dmar nag:

dbu dgu srin lus sbrul 'jug 'khyil: mog lus med par mi gis khyaings: phyag g.yas nyi zla nam mkhar 'phyar: g.yon pa yu gri me 'bar 'dzin: gdug pa sbrul gyi rgyen gyis brgyan: zhi ba'i nyabs dang rgyas pa'i byin: dbang bstud stobs dang rgyag po'i mthu: mchog thun byin ldan bdag ji bzhi: grangs med 'khor gyis bskor bar bsam: gnas gsum 'brus mtshan 'od 'phros pas: rtsa gsum byin brlabs par tu bstim: gzi brjid byin brlabs ldan pas bsam: yig 'bru gsum la brgya rtsa bzlas: de nas gsang ba'i dzāb 'dis bskul: hri shag ru ram na ge tsi ta kraṃ ma ma yong 'grab ha hi ke sha la ke ta dza dza : bzlas pas staung gsum sngags sgas gang: bdag dang khas gsum sems can gyi: lus ngag sdig sgrib nyes skyon zhi: gtug las gyur rtog tshogs sbyangs: skun bzang dpal chen ngo bor bya: snod bcud 'khor zhing ngar la bsdus: sbrul mjug mkha' la gtad de dengs: bskyed pa'i rdzogs pa e ma ho: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis la a nur bsgrub pa'i thams: 'khor 'das mnyam yangs 'khrugs pa yi: me rlung ser sprin glog 'gyu'i klong: bdag lus gza' bdu ra hu la: dbu dgu ther pa'i chos rim dgu: sku stod srin po thabs kyi sku: sku blad sbrul 'jug shes rab 'khyil: spyan ston bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong: phyag g.yas nyi zla dbyings rig ston: g.yon pa yu garis bar chod sel: sbrul brgyan che btsan 'gran zla bral: phras bzhi yi mnga' bdag ste: mchog gi bdag pa sku gsum 'chang: ye nas rang dang gnyis med pas: rang lus grub na lha ru rdzogs: rang dang lha bra dbyer med pas: spyan drangs mchod bstim bya mi dgos: bdag rtog mtshan 'dzin 'joms pa'i phyir: khal tsam sal yin tsam du: gsags hri: yis ba nyis med brtan: de la goms nas 'khor 'das kun: drang srong rā hu 'i skur go bzhin: dbyer med bltas la dzāb kyis bskul5

bdag nyid bsdus la ngang ngu bzhag: rdzogs pa'i rdzogs pa e ma ho: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa a tir brgub ni: rang gi rig pa stong gsal 'di: phyab 'jug chen po rā hu la: 'khor 'das yongs la khyab tsang rgyud: gnyis med ye shes don la 'jug: sgra ru grags pa'i snang srin chos: lnges spyang gis ni yongs 'joms ltar: 'dzin pa'i mthu mda' 'di la ni: sgra gcan 'dzin zhes rig pa'i dngos: dbu gdu bde gshegs sgrub ste dgu: lungs spyod rdzogs pa'i ngo bo nyid: bya rol dbu ni mi 'gyur ba: kun bzang dpal chen rdo rje 'dzin: sku yi spyon mig sangs rgyas: byang sems grangs med zhi lha rdzogs: phyag g.yas nyid zla bde ba che: spru gris bcod cing stong pa'i dbyings: gnyis med zung sbyor phyag gnyis tshul: sbrul 'jug thugs rje lcags thag ste: khams gsum 'khor ba gnas 'dren pa'i: 'phris mnga' bdag rang rig pa: phyab 'jug rā rur ye nas rdzogs: de bas snang srid 'khor 'das kyang: rang rog khyab 'jug nyid las min: gnyis med don las mi 'da' na: rgyu dang rkyen du phye ba med: ma rig ye shes gnyis su med: las dang 'bras bu gnyis su med: sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med: lho med srags stangs kyang yod med kyis ngang: rang rig ngang las nyi zla'i dbus: phyag mtshal nyi zla'i mtshams kyi dbus su: stong gsal ti la 'bru cig lta: mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du: gzi brjod chen 'od gsal ba'i: sgra gcan 'dzin pa mkhar gsal te: sku dang ye shes mthar phin nas: bar do med bar lhag med 'grub: rdzogs chen yang rdzogs e ma ho: rang rig khyab 'jug chen po sgra bcan 'dzin: ye shes su bsgrub pa'i rdzogs rim dgongs pa'i snying byang du gdams pa'i: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: pho rigs rmu bdud rdzogs rim gsum: dang po bya ba gong gis 'dres: dngos gzhi 'jig rten tshub khyil klong: ri skyes kham pa'i stong gnas pa:

bdag nyid badzra sā du'i sku: zhal cig phyag gnyis ber dkar gyon: rdo rje ru dar snying zhags 'dzin: snyug zhu dang ni sag lham can: mchog thun yon tan ldan pa yi: rang 'dras snang srid khyengs par bsam: gnas gsum 'bru las 'od 'phros pas: ye shes spyan drangs rang la bstim: yig gsum brgya brgyad sngags gyis brtan: de nas gsang ba'i 'jab 'dis bskul: badzra sa du tri li dza dza : bzlas pas stong gsum sngags sgras gang: bdag gsum khams gsum sems can gyi: lus ngag sdig sgrib nyes skyon zhi: zhe steng las gyur rtog tshogs sbyangs: badzra he rus ngo bor byas: snod bcud 'khor dang zhing khams rang la bsdus: do rje'i ce la gtad de dnges: bskyed pa'i rdzogs pa e ma sho: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa a nur bsgrub pa'i thabs5 zhing khams tshub mar 'khyim ba'i dbus: ra skyes steng da bdag nyid ni: skyes bu badzra thig le rtsal: don dam zhal gcig thabs shes phyag: thugs rje'i thabs kyi ber chen gsol: sangs rgyas thugs mchog rdo rje dang: rbayang sems zhags pa ru dar 'phyar: stong nyid sting rje'i ngo bo ste: bdag zhan don rdzogs rang lus gsal: ye nas gsol bdag dang gnyis med pas: bdag tu grub nas lha ru rdzogs: gzhan du snang snang kyang lha yi sku: lha dang bdag zhan dbyar med pas: spyan rgyangs mchod bstim byi mi 'tshal: bdag rtog mtshan 'dzin 'dzoms pa'i phyir: wal tsam gsal tsam yi tsam du: gsang rdzags tī yis gnyis med brtan: de lagoms nas 'khor 'das kun: dam tshig chen pa'i skur gong bzhin: dbyir med bltas la 'dzab kyis bskul: bdag nyid bsdus te ngang du bzhag: rdzogs pa'i rdzogs pa e ma ho: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa a tir bsgrub pa ni: rang shes rig pa'i rgyal po 'di: dam can badzra sa du ste: mi 'pho mi 'da' dam chig can: gnyis med ye shes rdo rje ste: legs pa nyid las nyes pa bral: zhal gcig thig le nyag gcig don:

phyag dang mchan la las mthar phyin: gzhon pa theg pa chen por rjogs: zhi dang khro ba'i dang tshul sogs: thams cad rig pa'i tsho 'phrul rtsal: rang ri rdo rje se ge nas legs: de bas snang rdzid 'khor 'das kyang: 'khor 'das dbyer med don la 'dud: 'dir ni chos skyong ma lus sa: bskyed dang rdzogs dang rdzogs pa cher: bsgrub pa'i mdo' 'gyog snyen po'i bcud: gzhan du ma ma bstan 'dir bshad bya: sā mā yā: spyir ni chos skyong bsam yas kyang: pho mo ma ning gsum las min: mo ni dkar po rmu mi rigs: zhes sdad cha 'dzin drag cing rtsub: mi ni nag mo ma mo'i rigs: 'dod tshogs cha 'dzin gan nag cing 'khren: ma ning khra pho gza' yi rigs: gti mug cha 'dzin kun gyi gco: rigs bsdus 'dir ni lcags dral du: ye shes chu gyi rdzogs rig bstan: dang po dben gnas yo byang bsag: phyi mug gsang ba'i mchams bcad bya: skyabs song chad med bzhi bsgoms nas: stong gsum sad nyi bam gyi ste: rang nyi dpal ldan sngags kyi bdag: dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: bka' bsrungs smug nag lcam dram bzhugs so: lcogs shog sngon po'i chos sde'o: 00000000: rtsa gsum zhi khro'i lha la 'dud: dam chos dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus pa'i: yang zab nyams su len pa la: phyi nang bar gcod sel ba'i phyir: bstan bsrungs drag rtsal kun 'dus pa: me 'dra thogs 'dra 'di gdams so: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: 'di la bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor gsum: gcig sgril bsgral ba'i las 'di bstan: dur khrod bas mtha' dben gnas su: du tshes brgyad la 'bru nag phyi: las byed zur gtor pharga brgyad data: gsang phyir gzugs brgyan pa la: sha khrag snying snas brgyan te bsham: dur khrod das bsam shog bu la: rang gi dri rlangs ma song bar: dag ling ming rus 'tshal gyis bris: dri ma ma bsegs pa'i spra tshil lam: bag zan kham pa gang rung gi: nya bo'i nang bcug e nang rtsal:

sngon dmar byar bcings steng drangs: lho nub gza' la shar lho ma: shar rnal 'byor du dam can gtor ma la: sna mo btad de gnyen bcol bya: brub khung ste du rtsa gsum gyi: gtor ma bzhag pas 'khu mi nus: khrag yung rdo dug 'tshon thun bsag: sman rag mchod pas tha ma bskor: gri lngags nag po ngor ldan bcang: rang nyid rtsa gsum phyag rdor ram: rta mgrin gang rung gsal ba'i g.yas: gza' bdu dmar nag rā hu lha: mog dgu mi lus sgrub 'jug can: mgo lus med par mig gis gang: phyag g.yas nyi zla phyir zhing rdeg: g.yon pa spru garis srog gcod: gdug pa sbrul gyi rgyan cha can: sprin rum me dpung klong na rngam: g.yon du ma mo 'khros ma'i rgyal: sngags bdag smug nag mche ba gtsigs: ru lu'i sgra sgrog mig gcig ma: g.yas pas dgra snying dmar po 'grad: g.yon pa thod khrag dmar la rol: bral la nu gcig bdag la ston: mdun du dam can tig le rtsal: 'khor smug g.yas na rda rje dang: g.yon pa ru dar dgra snying zhag rgyu 'dzin: dar dkar ber gyon ra la zhol: dbu la mon gyi snyug zhu gsol: 'khor du snang srid dregs pas bskor: bdag gis c-i bcol las byid bsam: drag po'i sngags 'di zhag gsum bzlas: e ru ru e ka tsa ti snying khar rag ru lu ru lu hūṃ bhyo hūṃ dza dza : badzra sa du tri ling dza dza: hri shag ru rag raṃ: na ge tshi ta trang: mdam yong za 'aghraṃ: ha hi ke sha la ke ta ke dza dza: dgra bo'i dbugs la rngag: srog la chum: rnaḥ tri hur thum dza dza: lam cho tam gtor tshe srog tung tung kham kham phaṭa: de ltar bzlas shing bsgrub pa'i bar: mchod gter dus bzhir 'bad cing bskul: brtags ni bud gar byed 'khrab: ban sngags mi ring g.yag rog 'khor: 'od sgra khyim 'tsheg nyams dngos 'byung: rtags ma gsal bar 'bad pa gces: de nas rang nyid khro mor bskyed: gza' dang dhor legs g.yas g.yon bsgom: las mkhan sde brgyand ma lus bskyed:

gsang sngags gong ma zhag gsum bzlas: bsad rtags byol song bsad dang gtubs: g.yul shom dmag 'khrul mtshon cha thogs: 'khrul pas rang rgyal cho 'phrul 'byung: de la 'jigs skrag mi bya bar: ngang ser sha tshil sgo nga bsreg: rang gi spyin bor phyag dhor dran: de nas btswo lnga'i nyi nub khar: mnyes dpang gzugs ho dang phral: gsang sngags stong bzlas thun gyis brab: de nas dngos rtags kyang 'byung: ling ga dug shing mer bsregs te: zhal gdab thal sol ru par bcas: gzhe mdod klu gnas gnyan par gtad: gtor ma gsum ni 'gyu phyogs bstun: dag yi kha khyim phyogs su 'phang: bsgrub shul mi macon brdul phyag gdab: mchod gtor gsol kha dag la 'bad: bla rdo spog chog byag med de: dam tshig bsgrub tshe nad gza'i mi gso: dme 'dze yugs sogs grib la 'dzem: bu med 'thab dang nyal po spang : de ltar gsang te bsgrubs spyod na: ma ltar byams shing srid ltar gdung: bskul na las myur 'khu ldom med: bcu bzhi dag las phyir mi 'gyang: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gab rgya: gsang rgya: dam rgya: bka' rgya: gnyan rgya: rgya dgus gdab ste gter du sbas: lcags shog sngon po'i ngos las 'bri gung pa ratnas spro lung skyed tshal du dag par phab po/// / gcig zhus//

dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: drag po gza'i gsang bsgrubs bzhugs: 00000: stobs chen drag po hūṃ la 'dud: spyir ni sangs rgyas bstan bsrung zhing: bye brag dgongs pa yang zab kyi: bka' bsrung mchog gyur 'di bstan no: sā mā yā: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: the kun gasdus 'der las: mthu stobs sa sprul rā sprul hū la: nga yi snying gi chos skyeng yin: sā mā yā: ngi yid la bcags pa'i bu: lha sras rje rgyal khyedi nyid la: da lta bstan bsrang mi dgos kyang: ma 'ongs skye brgyud tha ma la: so kha srung ba'i chos skyong 'tshal: dam du chongs la las la rbod: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgyaṃ: 'di la lo rgyud gdams pa dngos: dang po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis: gdug can zhi bas mi thul ba: drag por khyab 'jug sprul ste btul: sprul pa'i gzugs des sems skyed cing: spyinamanga' mngon shes dang ldan pas: rang stags srog gi snying po zul: bstan pa bsrung par dam bcas so de nas ston rnams kyis: dug mtsho khol dang khrag mtsho khol: bya rol brtsegs dang yu gra'i rgyud: zhal nas gsungs shing bdud rtsi ltar: khyag la rdo rje dbang skur zhing: ma 'ongs thal ba'i khebs pa yi: zhing khams su zhi sangs rgyal bstan: zhing stobs rdzul dpag med pas: gsang ba'i bdag pos lus brgyan dgos: de las gza' bdud chen po brgyad: da rgyug shul mi bzad la: padma 'byung gnas bdag nyid kyis: sngon gyis dam bsgrags ting nge 'dzi gzir: dran pa sos te srogs snying phul: brgyud 'dzin bstan bsrung khas blangs shing: lha gnas dga' ldan khrong du: ma dakharol bar du mi 'grol ba'i: lcags sgrog tha ram dam pos bcing: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: sems can dug lnga'i mas bsags pa'i: rnam smin lcags kyi sgro grol ste: lha srin kun gyi mtsha yo yin phyir: kho yi rnams sprul mang po ni: la la gza' ltar skugs shing skug:

la la klu ltar gleng zhing skyog: la la btsan ltar gzer zhing batshub: la la rgyal ltar smyi zhing 'bog: la la ma mo ji bzhin bshal: la la bdud ltar bying shing 'thibs: la la bshin ltar khror ni skyug: ma nges chos 'phrul snogs 'byung: de dusas grang srong 'di bsgrub na: grub thag nye zhing mthu rtsal che: 'di nyid rbad nas bsad na yang: pha rol na song gnas su mi ltu ste: dam tshig can gyi gnyer kha'o: sā mā yā: gnyis bsgrub pa'i ram pa ni: nam mkha' hom lung zhes bya ste: dgra yi dbyi zhing rang gi dgag: bdun du ba ling zer gsum pa:^ bshes bu dbus skor bza' bcer bshi: btung bas bran cing rang nyid ni: ye shes mgon po ra hu la: sku go thal nag zhal dgu pa: phyag bzhi g.yas son dang po gnyis: chu srin rgyal na sbrul zhags dang: 'og ma thod khrag mda' gzhu 'dzin: rgyan dang cha lugs spyin dang mthun: sku sbrul 'dzugasame chu glung: 'khrug pa'i dkyil du bzhugs par bsgoms: gro ga'am shog bu dag la ni: ling ga gsum bris g.yas phyogs su stam pa: g.yon du mu kha stam pa: snying gar ming rus bla dgas bris: yan lag dza: hū bam hos gzer mar spyi tshugs 'dzugs: gcig rang gi mal 'og sba: gcig ni srin bdags par bar du gdab: gsang ba sngags 'dis 'bod rbad pasad: hi shag ru rag raṃ na ge tse ta traṃ ma ma yod za 'graṃ: ha hi ke sha la dza dza: 'bod pa'i: a kro te ka hri ha sha ru ma ma za la rbad dza dza: rbad pa'o: che ge mo'i srog la ma ra ya rbad: srog rtsa la rbad: snying rtsa ba'o: rni ma ra srog la rbad: bsad pa'o: ka sra dun rnir: kha rag dun rnir rbad ma ra 'a dza dza : bsad pa'i sham bu'o: dgra yi hoṃ khung dbyed ba ni: dgabo gang la bya ba de'i: spyi gtsug nang hong yod par bsam: rang gi hoṃ khung dbye ba de'i: spyi gtsug nang hor yod par bsam: rang gi hoṃ khung dgag pa ni: skyes dar grir shi ba'i srid lag nang: sha rim bcug zangs mel bces:

spyi gtsug bcangs pas khu ldog dang: rang gi hoṃ khung 'bab mi srid: 'di yi blo rdo bzung ba ni bya pho ngang pa'i snying dang ni: pha wang long bu zangs ma'i khab: dung shong dar nag gis dril te: mchang 'og bcang pas bka' bzhin bsgrub: 'bod rmad bsad du ma rtags spyid mtshungs: ling kha bsreg cing thal ba gsum: gtor mar bsog cing zor du 'phang grub: rbad cing bskul ba drag dub bya: cha gcig rlungs sbyar dmod pa brjod: cha gcig lhi gnyan la gtad: de yi rtag shul las la 'gyur: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyen rgya: bka' rgya: dam rgya: rgya dgus btab te bstan pa bsrung ba'i lcags rir bskor so: o rgyan rin po che'i phrag yig lcags shog sngon po'i bu las 'bri gung pa ratnas bu tshal pho brang du phab pa'o: magha lam: sā mā yā: yang rang nyid lcags sdig nag por bsgom zhing: sa bhi ta na ye sā hā: zhes pa 'di zhag bdug brgyad na brgya rtsa te bzlas pas kyang chos go: 'di sgrub tshe dngos grub kho mig chen 'ong te mi 'jigadza pa gal che'o: sā mā yā: 'di bsgrub pa'i tshe dpal gtor dbus ma khog pa can du: ling ga dbu chachan char bcug la de la bshos bus bskor ram: ma bskor kyang nyan: dar mthing kha kha gang mdang bya rgod ma gcig la btag dngos grub so ngo: de la brten bya: rang skyed rim dang ldan pas: ngag bcad la 'bor sngags bzlas pas: bdun phrag gcig na dngos grub 'ongo: de na rbad cing bsar pa'i las rnams bdun bdun bya'o: 'bor pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas: gtor ma de āoṃ ā: hūm̐ gis byin brlabs cing 'bul ba ni: ke ta ke ta: rā hū la: ljang sngon drag po: rog ti nag po: bi tripa tra: bhi sbu ra rtsa: du ba 'jugs ring: khyab 'jug chen po: sgra bcan 'dzin gdangos ma bzhi dang bcas pa'i zhal du bha ying ta khā khā hi khā hi: gra bo 'di zhes bya mam ra ya sod: zhes bskul kyang 'gyed:

bstod pa yang bya'o: sā mā yā: kha tham: gza' dug chu log ma'i yig chung phyi rabs kyi ron du padmas gdams so: kha tham: khatham: kha tham: lcags shog gi chos sde las bu tshal pho brang du phab pa'o: lab gha lam: dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: phung byer gzha'i srog bsgrub dug gi 'khor lo bzhugs su: 00000: rtsa gsum lha lan mo hūṃ: nga yi bka' nyan las byed pa: ma srun gza' bdud gza' bdud hū la: kho bo'i bkol bde mthu bo che: ma 'ongs du su bstan pa 'byung: sangs rgyas kun gyi bka' bsgos de: dam chos spyod pa'i grogs byed cing: ro rkyeng dhu ti'i rung du sbyor: dam med nyes par spyod pa yi: bdud dang log badren ma rungs pa: skad gcig hur thum bsod bar byed de dang chos dang min spyod: kun gyi gnas skabs sog la rgyu: 'di dag bsgrub pa'i thabs pa'i thabs so so: gter kha kun du mang sbas kyang: 'dir ni gsang ba srag bsgrub thabs: zhag mthu nag po brdugs med 'di: lha sras bstan pa'i btsus su bzhag: dad po rdzas kyi bsags thabs ni: rang dug gis lo btsan du dang: chu rtsa thar nus sre mo'i brum: padme nag ma snyer na dmar khra'i ser khra' pe 'tshal dkar dang: cang rgod sbyar la ling ga bris: tha ma sngags kyis bskor bar bya: dpral ma shes na gha ddha rnir dza bar rus la snying rang ming: phung shul 'brub khung grub gsum bya: rol sol dug khrigs byugs te: nang du ling ga gan rkyal du: mgo ni rang la bstan te bzhag: steng du gong gi rdzas rnams dpung: zangs khabs sor bzhi sting 'khar gzugs :glang ba shing gi bgrang 'phreng bya: dngos bzhi rang di phyag rdo rje mdun: zangs khab 'jig rten rā hū la: gan po stod mi smad sbrul 'jug: mgo lus med pa mig gis gang: rtag gtum gzi brjed ldan par skyed: sa bsros nas ni nub bar du: zhag po gnyis gi sngags 'dis brab: ra hū la tri dung dung lā dza dza:

dgabo chen po mo mar ya: thuṃ thuṃ rnir la brad dam nyam 'di bsdus bsdus: ra bzhob gnam zhing rang nyid kyi: dpral ba 'thug kob lus sbyid 'byung: de dus nga ro mod bcal dang: ma nyes dpang gzugs shag mang gdab: brang brdung 'o dod 'bor par bya: de yis dgra bo'i bya ba rdzogs: rdzes kyi las 'jug bstan pa ni: ling ga rdzas dang bcas pa nyid: dam nyam de yi dug yin pas: rtil te sngo dbar skur pas bcing: gzi' dus dus 'gyur dus ma nor bar: tshas bcas dgra bo'i khang rmang mnan: lcags srag yod kyang bachar par nges: rā hū lha'i gsang bsgrub 'di: gzhan dang mi 'dra khe nyen chen: zhag gcig gnyed dgra deng phung: gnyid log rmugs na rang 'chi bas: 'di rtsam gcig la sdod thabs med: zhes snang rag po'i ngar ldan pas: the tshom bskyed mi rung ngo: 'di ni ral gri phyung rdeg yin: glo bur bsod par gdon mi za: rang las gzhan du dpel srid na: 'dra min chos gcig nga yi bka': gdos 'di spel thabs med do bu: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: dam rgya: bka' rgya: gnyan rgya: gza'i rgya: rgya dgus bta te go dar du sbas: rigs ldan sngags 'chang sbrul lo pa: ratna'i ming gis bsrung bar bskos: dam med na dbang po snub: las ldan de'i 'phris bsgrub : rā hū ma na ra kan: lcags shog sngon las: bya bral ratnas 'bri gung spro lung gi skyed 'tshal du bris so: maṃghalam: dge'o// gcig zhus/ dam dgongs pa yang zab: phung byed gza'i srog sgrub dug gi 'khor lo bzhugs so: rtsa gsum lha la na ma hūṃ: nga yi bka' nyan las byed pa: mi bsrun gza' bdud rā hū la: kho bo bkol bde mthu bo che: ma longs dus su bstan byung: sangs rgyas kun gyis bka' bsgoms te: dam chos spyod pa'i grog byed cing: ro rkyang rdu ti'i mrung du sbyor: dam med nyes par spyod pa yis: bdu dang log 'dren ma rungs pa:

skad cing shur thum gsod par byed: de phyir chos dang chos min spyod: kun gyi gnas skabs srog la rgyu: 'di bsgrub pa'i thabs so so: gter kha kun tu mang sbas kyang: 'dir ni gsang ba srog sgrub thabs: zhag mthu nag po bdug med 'di: lha sras bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag: dang po rjong gyi bsag thabs ni: ra dug gse zho btsan dug dang chu rtsa thar nus srau mo'i brun: padmo nam ma brnyen na dmar khro'am ser khra'o tshal dkar dang: cang rgod sbyar la ling ga bri: tha ma sngags kyis bskor bar bya: dpral bar dus lasnying ming: zung shul 'grub khung grub gsum bya: ro sol dug khrag gis byug te: nang du ling ga gan rgyal du: mgo la bstan de bzhan stong gong gi rdzas rnams dpung: zangs khab sor bzhi snying khar gzugs: glang ba shing gi bgrang phring bya: dngos bzhi rang nyid phyag rdor mdun: zangs khab 'jig rten rā nu la: nag po bstod mi smad sbrul 'jug: mgo lus med pa'i mig gi gang: drag matum gzi brjod ldan par bskyed: sa bsros nas ni nabar tu: zhag po gcig gis sngags 'di brab: rā hu la tri dung dung lā dza dza: dgro bo chen po mo ma ra ya: thum thum rni rbad nyams 'di la bsdus bsdus: nyungs dkar nyungs nag skye tsho dang: gong gi rdzas rnams bsras byas te: lcags kyi thur mas gzugs la brdeg: grub rtags zhug dri chil chil dang: ra gzhob gnam zhing rang nyid kying: dpral ba bathug kob lus sbyid 'byung: de dus nga ro dmod bcod dang: ma nyes dpang gzugs shag mnga' gdab: brang brtung 'o dod 'bod par bya: de yis dgra bo'i bya ba rdzogs : rjes kyi las 'jug bstan pa ni: lang ga rdzas dang bcas nyid: dam nyams yi dug yin pas: dril te sngo dmar skud pas bcing: gza' dus 'gyu dus nor bar: tshas bcas dgra bo'i khang rmang mnan: lcags srog yod kyi 'chad par ngos: rā hu lha yi gsang sgrub 'di: gzhan mi 'dra khe nyen che:

gzha gcig ma nyid dgro de phung: gnyid log rmugs na rang 'chi bas: 'di rtsams cig la bsdod thabs med: zhe sdang drag po'i ngar ldan pas: the tshom bskyed du mi rung ngo: 'di ni ral gri phung rdeg yin: blo bur gsod par gdon mi za: rag las gzhan du spel srid ni: 'dri mi chos cig nga yi bka': dngos 'di spel thabs med de do bu: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: dam rgya: bka' rgya: gnyan rgya: gza'i rgya: rgya dgus btab ste gter du sbas: rig ldan sngags 'chang sbrul mo pa: ratna'i ming gi bsrungs mar bskos: dmer len na dbang po bsnubs: las ldan de'i phris sgrubs: rā hu la na rakan: lcags shog sngon po las bya bral ratnas 'bri gung spro lus gi skyed tshad du blis so: shubhaṃ: gcig zhus// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: bsrung bzlog rigs lnga khrag thun zhes bya bzhugs so: lcags shog sngon po'i chos sde'o: 00000:bsrung bzlog rigs lnga khrag thun zhes bya ba: rigs lnga'i lha la phyog 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: swa pa gling gi dur khrod du: ye shes las kyi ḍa kki ma: srog nas bos te bskur ba na: ye rdo rje phag mo dang: mu rtogs lha mo seng ge'i gdong: 'khor dang bcas pa'i gzugs bstan nas: phyi nang khra men ba'i tshog: bsrung zhing bzlog pa'i bcud 'di gtigs: de las rang dang bsrung bya bsrung: gzhan gyi byad stems bzlogs pa'o: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: bsrung na tin bslos pa las: thun gyi bsgrub pa mi 'tshal te: rtsa ba gsum la skyabs song zhing: byung bsgrub par sems bskyed de: rang nyams hūṃ yig mthing nag las: ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ni: rigs 'dus nag mo seng ge'i gdong: spyi gatshum phag zhal nam mkhar ngur: g.yas g.yon pu ti tsakra bskor: g.yon brkyeng mo dpung dbus na bzhugs thod ba skam rlon dbu brgyad spras: stag sham zhing chen g.yang gzhi dang:

glang chen spags gos su gyon: dpral bar āoṃ las rnam snang 'khor so dri sa bu dkar: sangs rgyas yab yum gri thod dang bcas par bsgom: mgrin par āḥlas snang mtha' padma dril bu dmar: padma'i yab yum dang bcas par bsgom: rdo rje dril bu snying gar hūṃ las mi bskyed mthing: rda rje yab yum dang bcas par bsgom: lte bar rin chen dril bu sa las rin 'byung ser: ratna'i yab yum dang bcas par bsgom: gsar bar hā rgya gri dril bu las don grub rjang: karma'i yab yum gri thod dang bcas par bsgom: gnas gsum theg le dkar dang dmar: nyi zla ga'u kha sbor bdus: āoṃ āḥdang hūṃ gi mthar: drig lnga mkha' 'gro'i srog 'di bzlas: 'od 'phris phyi nang ye shes dang: lo ka'i nus mthu rang la bstim: mthu dpal gzi brjod ldan par bsam: rig lnga mkha' 'gro'i srid 'di bzlas: āoṃ tri ka dhi: tri mu dhi: tri lo ka sa ta ni: tri ma ra na: rmad kha byad stems ma ra la hūṃ phaṭa: rang dang dbyir med gyur pa yi: gnas lnga'i lha las 'od 'phros pas: ba yu'i bu ga tshun chad ni: lnga ldan khro bos gang ba yis: dir dir bzlas shing 'ja' tshon lngas mi khang khyam bcas pa sgrib: gnod byeng kun gyi mi mthong bsam: gsang ba sngags kyi grangs bstan pa: dgos pa tsam la nyer gcig ste: byad yod nges na brgya rtsa brgyad: babya ma mang zhing rtags nges na: gnyis pa bzlog na thun bsgrub ste: mdun du grub khung nag po'i nang: thod nang gcig tu thun 'dze thod yin pa bsags la: dug sna dang ni khrag 'dze khrag spang snan tshags: yung dkar yung nag kyi sheng rtsa: zangs lcags phyi ma dkar na rdo: ngan gsum phye gsum yugs pa ni: gsum gyi go thal gyis bkang ba'i: kha bcad dkyil āoṃ bhi rtsugs: de yang thebs bcad sngags bzla'o: stong stong mtshas gsum hus gdab dbye: thun rnams khro bo khro mo'i tshogs:

bzlog pa'i zer rdzas thogs nas ni: myur 'gyogs rtsal dang ldan par bsam: grub dang bzlog pa'i rtags rdzogs nas: drag po'i sa la zur gsum dbyibs: nag du thun rdzas blug byas la: dgaphyogs 'phang zhing khro chung tshogs: skar mda' lta bur song nas ni: byed ma 'khor bcas klag par bsam: dgong bzhin zur gsum bdun na them: nyi shu rtsa gcig zer rdzogs nas: byad ma 'phung bar the tshom med: 'di lta ba'ui bsrung bzlog mchog: bya bsla tshog chung yang zab 'di: skal ldan ri tsam ma gtogs pa: gter kha mang du rtsal ba med: phyi dus sras rgyal bu ni: phyi nang bdud sprul mang po dang: mthu rtsal 'dren pa'i dus su dgos: snying la bstim mo akṣaṃ rgya: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: bka' rgya: dam rgya: lcags shog sngon po'i ngos las ratnas 'bri gung spro lung gi skyed tshal du phab pa'o// gcig zhus//

dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: gangs ba snying byang gi sngon byung gleng gzhi bzhugs so: 0000000: bcom ldan 'das dpal sku gsum 'dus pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo: sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas kyi thugs rang gsal dri ma med pa'i ngang las: 'gro drug gi sems can las dag pa rnams kyi snang ngor: 'phagasha pa pyan sras gzigs kyi rnal 'byor byon pa las: slar snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rmu rgod gdug pa can 'dul ba'i don du: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas ni: rda na ko sha 'i mtsho dbus me tog padma'i sdong bu'i sbubs las 'khrungs te: rgyal po in tri dho'i sras su blangs nas rgyal pas dbang bskur ba la: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams bskul ba'i tshul mdzad: brtul shugs kyi spod pas rgyal po'i khrims dkral nas: de'i rkyen gyis gsil ba'i tshal sogs dur khrod chen po rnams ku tu rgyus: slob dpon rig 'dzin rnams dang 'jal zhing mod sngags kyi chos la blo sbyangs: mchog dang thun gi mos grub pa thob: sngags phyi nang gi lha ma lus pa dngos su 'jal zhing byin gyis brlabs: ye shes dang las kyi ḍakki ma thams cad du bsdus shing: 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can sde brgyad bran du bkol ba'i tshe: o rgyan rdo rje gling phug tu dgongs pa la bzhugs pa na: nub gcig nam srid kyi dus la bab pa'i tshe: srid pa gsum na nga rgyal dang gdug rtsab che ba'i gza' klu dpun gsum gyis matso byas pa'i drag byed dpag tu med pas: bdag la nyams tshad du bayutsang ba la: bdag nyid padmas dregs pa can de rnams 'dul ba'i phyir du: mi rtag pa'i lus la snying po mod par rtogs pas 'khris pa bcad: 'chi bdag gi bdud bzhom par bya ba'i phyir du lus 'chi mayad dbang por byin gyis brlabs: thugs snying rje chen po'i skur bstan nas gdug pa can thams cad zhi ba'i sems can byas: de nyid khros pa las dpal a ya ghri war sprul pas gnod sbyin bu dpun gsum gzir zhing dam la btags pa'i tshe:

padma'i rigs kyi srigs kyi srigs mo padma' lcam zhes bya ba: las kyi phyag rgyar phul te 'di skad zhus so: kyai: skye shi gnyis spangs 'gyur meyad rdo rje'i sku: tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis dam pa'i chos sgra bsgrog: mkhyen pa'i ye shes nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku labastod: bdag cag las ngan dbang gis gnod sbyin rigs: ki kang thog 'bebabs drag po gza' bdud dang: sha lang ges gdong klu mo gnyis kyi bu: tha ra ra gha ra dpun gsum ni: smon lam dbang gis mi bsrun gzugs bzung nas: skye 'gro kun la gnod pa'i sbyor ba bsgyis: rgya ba'i sku la nongs bcas bzod par gsol: bdag cag gsum gyi srid gc-ig padma lcam: bde shegs sku la chags pa mi mnga' yang: lus dang long spyod bcas pa dbul gyis bzhes: ma 'ongs gsang sngags snying po'i don spyod cing: dam tshig bsgrub pa'i grogs su lung bston 'tshal: bdag cag gsum kyang shag thub bstan pa'i bar: mi bsrun drag po'i gzugs 'dis rje nyid kyi: bka' yi gsang ba gnyer du bcang bgyi zhing: byuṃb bsgrub pa'i lam gyi bar macod pa'i: log 'dren 'tshar gachod pho nyar bdag gyur cig: zhes rang gi srog snying 'dongs gsol du phul te: smon lam bab po: de nas bdag 'dra padmas byin brlabs thugs rje gcig ma'i dkyil 'khor tu dbang bskur: phyi ltar dal 'byor gyi lus la snying po med pas 'khril ba btsan thabs su bcad de 'jig rten 'di'i so tshis bskyung ba: nang ltar 'chi ba glo bur bsam te dge ba'i chos la bsam pa: gsang ba 'chi bdagi bdud 'joms pa sangs rgyas snang ma mtha' yas yi ge gcig mar bsgrub pa: phyi ltar lha thugs rje po spyan ras gzigs yin pas sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems bsgom pa: nang ltar gzhan thams cad thugs rje chen po la yi ge drug gis gsol ba gdab pa: gsang ba spyan gzigs yi ge gcig mar bsgrub pa:

yang phyi ltar byub bsgrub pa'i bar gcod dang gdon bgogs tshar macod pa sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgom pa: nang ltar khro bo rta mgrin du bsgom zhing a ya bhri wa'i gsang glu blang ba: gsang ba lda gcag sngags gcig gis bdag dgra don gnyis med du ma zla ba: ku 'dus bka' bsrungs gza' klu ha ra nag po la rten nas bstan pa'i so kha b.rung gnyer gtad pa la: phyi ltar 'jir rten pa ha ra nag por bsgrubs pas 'khor ba gzengs bstod pa dang: nang ltar ye shes pa ha ra naka por bsgrubs pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i khungs dbyung ba: gsang ba gnyis med ha ra napa por bsgrubs pas bar gcod 'byin pa: de rnams su sdems nas gnod sbyin ming sring byub la bkod nas : ma longs pa na sor po smin lam btab pa ltar 'grub par lung bstan: de yang de'i dus rgya gar shar phyogs na rgyal po dharma a sho ka zhes bya ba: padma bdag dang smon lam gcig pa gsang sngags grub pa'i rigs can gcig yod pa: ma longs skyed ba mang du brgyud de: bdag yul gangs kyi ra bar chos skyong ba'i rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas 'gro ba'i don byed pa de'i don du gdams bskor 'di rnams yi ger b.ris nas bod du kher ba yin no: a ma yid la bcags pa'i bu khyod la: gsang ba snying byang bu dmar po'i bskor: gter kha kun tu ma rtsal snying po'i don: mdor bsdus gnad du dril ba 'di nyid bstan: dam ldan bu las kun la 'di ma bstan: gza' klu ha ra nag pos bka' 'di bsrung: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: lha sra kyi phyag yig 'chong shog smug po'i ngos las 'bri gung bya bral bas/ dus la bab par sprod lung gi skyed mo tshal du dag paraphab pa'o// gcig zhus// dam chos dgongs yang zab las: gsang ba snying byang gi bskor snang ba mtha' yas phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs: yi ge gcig zhes bya ba bzhugs so: 00000:0bcom ldan 'das dpal sku gsum 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo:

de nas o rgyan rdo rje mi shigs pa'i gling phug te nyid du: bdag 'dra padma dbang gi smin par byas pa'i gnod sbyin ming srid gis gtso byas pa'i dregs can rnams la phyi ltar dal 'byor dang ldan pa'i lus la'ang snying po med pas 'khri ba btsan thabs su bced 'jig rten 'di'i so tshis skyung ba 'di smras so: skye ma skye ma 'khor bar 'khrul pa yi: rigs drug khams gsum sems can nga la nyon: lha yi gnas yul rin chen gzhal med khang: bkod pa mchog mang bsdus blta bas chog mi shes: 'dod pa'i yon tan du mas gsum legs pas brgyan: lha'i lus dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs: tse log grangs mang bsdus 'tsho ba med: bde skyid dpal la spyod pa'i gnas yin kyang: mi rtag 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na: lus kyi 'od nyams rgyan dang bkrag mdangs nyams : stan la mi tshul grogs kyi ring du spangs: 'dod yon rdzas zad mi snyen sgra yang thob: snga ma'i bras zad bag med dbang gyu pa'i: gti mug gis drangs ngan skye ba mthong: tshe gang spyod pa'i bod skyed rmi lab 'dra: phyi mar 'jigs kyang skyabs dang skyobs pa med: de ltar lha yi bod ba grags che yang: snying po med na gang la yid brtan rung: de phyir 'jig rten bed gengs med pas: lha yul chags sems gdung ba'i 'gri ba chod: lha min rnams ni ri rab zom shed na: rang snang las grub ren chen ri bo dang: rdzing skyed tshal rin chen la grub pa'i: grong dang grong khyer bkod pa du mar bcas: 'dod yon lnga yis kun nas brgyan pa la: go cha mtshon rnams rin chen rgyu las grub: gnas dus bde lha yul 'drar rung kyang: rag gi bde bas chog shes mod pa la: lha yi bdud dpag bsam 'bras ba dang: lha yi bu mo la ni phra dog pas: dag gis dpung bcas 'thab cing 'gyed par brtson: sngon gyi bsod nams thams cad bsam ngan de'i: skad gcig gis zad 'gyur 'thabs pa'i tsho: lha yi bsod nams mi thub pham pa na:

'jig rten 'dir ni g.yul nyes bsdus bzhin: pha ma phu nu khyo shub shi ba yi: mya ngan gdung ba bzod klags med bzhin du: slor yang chags sdang 'du shes 'khrugs pa yis: sngar bzhin bsdul de ltar rgyun chad med: de ltar lha min gnas kyang bsdul bas: gnas skabs bde ba'i gnas la 'khri ba ched: mi yi gnas na midabang 'khor los bsgyur: dpun 'khor yang g.yog nying bran bcas shing: bkra shis rtags dang rgyal sid rin chen bdun: longs spyod dpal 'byor mnga' thang rab rgyas te: rgyal khams kun la dbang bsgyur stobs ldan kyi: bsod nams las kyi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe: me tog tshal chen mos nongs pa ltar: skad gcig mi rtag mdang mi rmi lam 'dra: sngar dpyad bed ba sgyu ma sprul par mtshungs : da lta'i bsdul gzhan bas lhag par che: spyi khyab skye rga na 'chi'i bsdul las: thar pa'i dus med zo chu'i khyud mod mtshungs: gzhan yang rang gis bces par bskyengs pa'i lus: gnyen bshes grog dang yul 'khor khyam la sogs: gang gi phyogs su 'bad pa bya na yang: de yis mi phan rnam smin rang la sdig: de ltar 'argyor ldan pa'i mi lus kyang: snying po med do 'jig rten bde 'bral la: ma zhen ma 'phreng po tshis 'khri ba skyungs: khyad par gnod sbyin mi sring khyod cag kyang: sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi bstan pa la: 'dres ma'i tshogs bsags dge ba'i 'bras bu yis: stobs chen drag po'i dpal dang ldan gyur kyang: sngon bsag 'bras zad tshe 'dir ma bsgrubs na: slar yang 'khor ba'i yang bran nyid 'khor zhing: dug lnga'i las 'bras rang smin pa'i phyir: thar med du kha'i las la pyod 'gyur bas: gnod sbyin ming sring gdug rtsub nga rgyal gyi bsam pa zhi te: yid skyo bas 'chi ma 'khrug cing rag gi lus dang longs spyod la chags pa'i bsam pa bor te: gus par btud nas drung du 'khod par gyur te: sā mā yā: 00000: de nas yang nang ltar 'chi ba la bsam zhing dge ba'i chos la bskul ba 'di smin so:

kye ma gnod sbyin ming srid bdag la nyon: lus 'di mi rtag rtsa yi sgran me 'dra: ngag 'di mi rtag brag cha'i sgra dang 'dra: tshe 'di mi rtag chu rgyun chad pa 'dra: srog 'di mi rtag la kha'i na bun 'dra: 'dus pa'i phung po khrag gi sbu ba 'dra: skye rtsam nyid nas 'chi bdag bdud dang nye: gom gang 'gro yun 'chi bdag bdud dang nye: zan za'i yun kyang 'chi bdag bdud dang nye: skom btung yun kyang bdag bdud dang nye: ska gcig yun kyang 'chi bdag bdud dang nye: de la dpa' dang dpung gis byar mi rnyed: de la sde dang phyogs kyis byar mi rnyed: de la nor dang mdzangs kyis byar mi rnyed: 'chi bdag grogs su ma rgyu gang med de: gcos par gsol pa'i sgyu lus phung po yis: 'chi bdag grog bo g.yob pa'i rgyu byed cing: dgra dang gnyen kyang 'chi bdag grogs su byed: longs spyod dpal 'byor ldan kyang 'chi 'chi bdag grogs: yal mkhar khyim du bcas kyang 'chi bdag grogs: gnas skabs srog 'dzin gza' bdag grogs su byed: de ltar dbang matsan 'chi bdag kho byung tshe: las 'bras mi bslu me long byad bzhin ltar: ji ltar 'dir phyad phyi ma rang la smin: 'dod chags las kyis yid gtags bkros skom dang: zhes sdang las kyis dmyal ba'i tsha grang myong: gti mugs las kyis dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal rnams: 'grang gis mi lang 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras grub: de bas du gsum mi dge'i phyogs spang zhing: chags med zhe sdang med dang gti mug med: ga rgyal phrag dog spang mi bar 'bad pa byod: zhes smras pas: thams cad mi dge log pa'i bsam pa ring du spangs te: dkar po dge ba'i lam la 'dun par gyur to: sā mā yā: 00000: de nas yang gsang ba 'chi bdag bdud 'joms par sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas yig ge gcig mar bsgrubs pa'i thabs 'di smras so: kye ma gnod sbyin ming sring bdag la nyon: de ltar 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing snying po med pa 'chi ba'i ring na la:

'chi med rtag pa'i skyabs gcig btsal re ran: lha yi snying po sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: bde gshegs thugs rje'i 'od dpag med: sngags kyi snying po yang snying yig ge sku lnga ye shes lnga rdzogs lnga 'joms: tig 'dzin snying po 'gyur med rdo rje'i thugs: thugs mchog 'dus pa brjod bral ti la ka: 'di nyid nyams blangs 'od gsal chos sku 'grub: sā mā yā: de yang las byang gzhung bsrang dkyil 'khor dbus: 'khor ba'i don mdzad chags tshul padma dmar 'dab brgyad ge par dbus su snang dang stong: thong pa kun rdzogs nyi ma zla ba'i stong: bdag bde gshegs kun 'dus snang mtha' yas: chags bral sku mdog padma rā ga'i mdang: don dam zhal gcig thabs phyag zhabs zung: mtha' gnyis mi gnas skyil dkrungs mnyam gzhan rgya: sku yi mtha' bral gtsug gtor ltar mi gangon: 'gro ba mchog rtsal bachi lhung bzed nang med bdud dam 'chang: rnam dag khrims ldan chos gos rnam gsum gsol: bdag gzhan don rdzogs mtshan dpe ldan par bsgom: spyan drangs bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul: bstod cing bzlas la rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom: tshogs phud drang smon lam gdab cing bsngo: bskul bzlog chad mod bstan skyangs mnan bro dang: bsngo smon gshegs bsdu shis brjod las gzhung bsrang: de ltar rna man ngag ltar bsgrubs pas: grub pa'i rtags ni dngos nyams rmi lam du: bla ma khyi'u bu mos long ston dang: chos 'chad dbang bskur tshe'i mtshan ma bston: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jig skyebs rgyun 'bad na: 'chi med rig 'dzin brnyes shing don dam sku: gzhom bral rdo rje'i ska gsung thugs 'grub 'gyur: sā mā yā: gtad gnod sbyin ming sring gnyis: nyams su longs la 'khor ba'i mtha' chod gcig: ma 'ongs lha sras rgyal po'i chos su gtad: de kyang bzhi bcur nye ba'i dus kyi tshe: rje'i rims la ratna'i ming ldan pa: mtha' 'khob dug lnga spyod pa'i gangs kyi rar:

skye ba bzung tshe chos mang kha g.yol du: rang nyams long la las ldan bu la spel: ha ra nag po la ni bka' 'di gnyer: dus min len na de yi dbang po bsnubs: dus la bab tshe las ldan bu la sprod: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: lha sras kyis phyag yig 'chong shog smug po las: shog dkar lo gsum 'bri gung pa ratna dus la bab par spro lung gi skyed tshal du dag par phab pa'o/// gcig zhus//
